source.text: וְ֠נַעֲמָן שַׂר־צְבָ֨א מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָ֜ם הָיָ֣ה אִישׁ֩ גָּד֨וֹל לִפְנֵ֤י אֲדֹנָיו֙ וּנְשֻׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים כִּֽי־ב֛וֹ נָֽתַן־יְהוָ֥ה תְּשׁוּעָ֖ה לַאֲרָ֑ם וְהָאִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֛ה גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֖יִל מְצֹרָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: And Naaman, commander of [the] army of [the] king of Aram, was a man great before his master and lifted up of face, for by him had given Yahweh victory to Aram; and the man was a mighty man of valor, having scale disease.

en.L: Now Naaman, commander of the army of the king of Aram, was a great man before his master and lifted up of face, for by him {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had given victory to Aram. And the man was a mighty man of valor, with scale disease.
en.B: Naaman was commander of the army of the king of Aram. His master regarded him as a great man and held him in high honor, because through him {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had given victory to Aram. He was a mighty warrior, but he had a serious skin disease.
en.R: Naaman was the army commander for the king of Aram. His master thought very highly of him and honored him, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had used Naaman to give Aram victory. Naaman was a strong and brave soldier, but he had a serious skin disease.

es.L: Y Naamán, jefe del ejército del rey de Aram, era un hombre grande delante de su señor y enaltecido de rostro, porque por medio de él {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dado la victoria a Aram. Y el hombre era un valiente guerrero, [pero] con enfermedad de la piel.
es.B: Naamán era jefe del ejército del rey de Aram. Su señor lo tenía por un gran hombre y lo estimaba mucho, porque por medio de él {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dado la victoria a Aram. Era un guerrero valiente, pero tenía una enfermedad grave de la piel.
es.R: Naamán era el jefe del ejército del rey de Aram. Su señor lo apreciaba mucho y lo honraba, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había usado a Naamán para darle la victoria a Aram. Naamán era un soldado fuerte y valiente, pero tenía una enfermedad grave de la piel.

fr.L: Or Naaman, chef de l’armée du roi d’Aram, était un homme grand devant son maître et élevé de visage, car par lui {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait donné la victoire à Aram. Et l’homme était un vaillant guerrier, atteint d’une maladie de la peau.
fr.B: Naaman était chef de l’armée du roi d’Aram. Son maître le tenait pour un grand homme et l’honorait beaucoup, car c’est par lui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait donné la victoire à Aram. C’était un vaillant guerrier, mais il avait une maladie de peau grave.
fr.R: Naaman était le chef de l’armée du roi d’Aram. Son maître l’estimait beaucoup et l’honorait, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’était servi de Naaman pour donner la victoire à Aram. Naaman était un soldat fort et courageux, mais il avait une maladie de peau grave.

sw.L: Basi Naamani, jemadari wa jeshi la mfalme wa Aramu, alikuwa mtu mkuu mbele ya bwana wake na mwenye kuinuliwa uso, kwa maana kupitia yeye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewapa Aramu ushindi. Naye mtu huyo alikuwa shujaa hodari, mwenye ugonjwa wa ngozi.
sw.B: Naamani alikuwa mkuu wa jeshi la mfalme wa Aramu. Bwana wake alimwona kuwa mtu mkuu na kumheshimu sana, kwa sababu kupitia yeye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewapa Aramu ushindi. Alikuwa shujaa hodari, lakini alikuwa na ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi.
sw.R: Naamani alikuwa mkuu wa jeshi la mfalme wa Aramu. Bwana wake alimthamini sana na kumheshimu, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemtumia Naamani kuwapa Aramu ushindi. Naamani alikuwa askari hodari na jasiri, lakini alikuwa na ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi.

vi.L: Na-a-man, tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua A-ram, là một người lớn trước mặt chủ mình và được trọng vọng, vì nhờ ông mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban chiến thắng cho A-ram. Người ấy là một dũng sĩ mạnh mẽ, nhưng mắc bệnh phung.
vi.B: Na-a-man là tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua A-ram. Ông được chủ mình xem là người lớn và hết sức trọng vọng, vì nhờ ông mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban chiến thắng cho A-ram. Ông là một chiến binh dũng mãnh, nhưng lại mắc một bệnh ngoài da nặng.
vi.R: Na-a-man là tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua A-ram. Chủ ông rất quý trọng ông, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dùng Na-a-man để cho A-ram chiến thắng. Na-a-man là một người lính mạnh mẽ và can đảm, nhưng ông mắc một bệnh ngoài da nặng.

ko.L: 그리고 아람 왕의 군대 사령관 나아만은 그의 주인 앞에서 큰 사람이었고 얼굴이 들린 사람이었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 통하여 아람에게 승리를 주셨기 때문이다. 그리고 그 사람은 큰 용사였으나 악성 피부병이 있었다.
ko.B: 나아만은 아람 왕의 군대 사령관이었다. 그의 주인은 그를 훌륭한 사람으로 여기고 높이 대우했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 통해 아람에게 승리를 주셨기 때문이다. 그는 힘센 용사였으나 심한 피부병을 앓고 있었다.
ko.R: 나아만은 아람 왕의 군대 사령관이었다. 아람 왕은 그를 매우 훌륭하게 여기고 존중했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나아만을 써서 아람이 전쟁에서 이기게 하셨기 때문이다. 나아만은 힘이 세고 용감한 군인이었다. 그러나 그는 심한 피부병을 앓고 있었다.

decisions.choice: scale disease: a serious skin condition that made a person unclean, not modern leprosy
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the skin diseases of Leviticus 13-14, which are known by visible signs such as raw or flaking patches and hair turning white (Leviticus 13:2-44). Leprosy as known today (Hansen's disease) does not fit those signs well, and the same word is used of a growth in cloth and in house walls (Leviticus 13:47; 14:34). Naaman still serves at court and goes into a temple with his king (verse 18), so Aram did not keep him apart as Israel's law required (Leviticus 13:45-46).

decisions.choice: lifted up of face: held in high honor
decisions.reason: To "lift up someone's face" is to receive him with favor and respect (Genesis 32:21; Job 42:8-9). Naaman stands high in his king's favor, and the next words give the reason.

decisions.choice: Yahweh had given victory to Aram through Naaman
alternatives: the gods of Aram had given the victory
decisions.reason: The writer says that Aram's successes came from Yahweh, the God of Israel, even though Aram did not worship him. Yahweh rules over the nations around Israel too (1 Kings 19:15). The story will end with this foreign commander confessing Yahweh as the only God (verse 15).

decisions.choice: Aram: the kingdom north-east of Israel, with Damascus as its capital
decisions.reason: Aram (Syria) and Israel were often at war in these years (1 Kings 20; 22; 2 Kings 6:8-7:20). The king is not named here; Damascus is its capital (verse 12).

decisions.choice: scale disease (Literal); serious skin disease (Balanced, Readable); mighty man of valor (Literal), mighty warrior (Balanced), strong and brave soldier (Readable)
decisions.reason: The disease is named as in Leviticus 13, so the reader can see that it is the same condition the law describes. Balanced and Readable add "but" to show the contrast the Hebrew makes by setting the disease last.

decisions.choice: enfermedad de la piel (Literal); enfermedad grave de la piel (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The disease is named as in the Spanish of Leviticus 13, so the reader can see it is the condition the law describes; "lepra" would suggest modern leprosy (m1).

decisions.choice: "une maladie de la peau" (L); "une maladie de peau grave" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the French Samuel drafts for *tsaraʿat*: the meaning decision says it is not modern leprosy, so French avoids "lèpre".

decisions.choice: "ugonjwa wa ngozi" (Literal); "ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The disease is named as in the Swahili Leviticus 13, so the reader can see that it is the condition the law describes; "ukoma" would suggest modern leprosy, which the meaning note rules out.

decisions.choice: "bệnh phung" (L); "bệnh ngoài da nặng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A serious skin disease that made a person unclean, not modern leprosy (m1); the same pair of words as the Vietnamese Luke 4:27, which names Naaman.

decisions.choice: "A-ram"
decisions.reason: The kingdom keeps its Hebrew name, as the terms note spells it; Luke 4:27 says "người Sy-ri" because the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "악성 피부병" (L) and "심한 피부병" (B, R) for "scale disease"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the disease is not modern leprosy; "나병" would name it, and "문둥병" is also a slur. The Korean words describe a serious skin disease without naming one.

decisions.choice: "얼굴이 들린 사람" at Literal for "lifted up of face"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, explained by the meaning decision (m2); Balanced and Readable say he was honored.

source.text: וַאֲרָם֙ יָצְא֣וּ גְדוּדִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁבּ֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נַעֲרָ֣ה קְטַנָּ֑ה וַתְּהִ֕י לִפְנֵ֖י אֵ֥שֶׁת נַעֲמָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Aram had gone out [in] raiding bands and had taken captive from [the] land of Israel a girl young, and she was before [the] wife of Naaman.

en.L: And Aram had gone out [in] raiding bands and had taken captive from the land of Israel a young girl, and she was before the wife of Naaman.
en.B: Raiding parties from Aram had gone out and had taken a young girl captive from the land of Israel, and she served Naaman's wife.
en.R: Some time before, soldiers from Aram had gone on raids into the land of Israel. They had captured a young girl, and she became a servant to Naaman's wife.

es.L: Y Aram había salido [en] bandas y había llevado cautiva de la tierra de Israel a una muchacha pequeña, y ella estaba delante de la mujer de Naamán.
es.B: Unas bandas de Aram habían salido y se habían llevado cautiva de la tierra de Israel a una muchacha, que servía a la mujer de Naamán.
es.R: Tiempo atrás, unos soldados de Aram habían hecho incursiones en la tierra de Israel. Se habían llevado presa a una muchacha, que llegó a ser criada de la mujer de Naamán.

fr.L: Et Aram était sorti [en] bandes de pillards, et ils avaient emmené captive du pays d’Israël une petite fille, et elle était devant la femme de Naaman.
fr.B: Des bandes de pillards araméens étaient sorties et avaient emmené captive du pays d’Israël une petite fille, qui était au service de la femme de Naaman.
fr.R: Quelque temps auparavant, des soldats d’Aram avaient fait des attaques dans le pays d’Israël. Ils avaient capturé une petite fille, et elle était devenue la servante de la femme de Naaman.

sw.L: Na Waaramu walikuwa wametoka [kwa] vikosi vya uvamizi, wakachukua mateka kutoka nchi ya Israeli msichana mdogo, naye akawa mbele ya mke wa Naamani.
sw.B: Vikosi vya uvamizi vya Waaramu vilikuwa vimetoka, vikachukua mateka msichana mdogo kutoka nchi ya Israeli, naye akamtumikia mke wa Naamani.
sw.R: Wakati fulani kabla ya hapo, askari wa Aramu walikuwa wamevamia nchi ya Israeli. Walimteka msichana mdogo, naye akawa mtumishi wa mke wa Naamani.

vi.L: Người A-ram đã đi ra thành từng toán cướp phá và bắt từ xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên một cô gái nhỏ, và cô hầu hạ trước mặt vợ Na-a-man.
vi.B: Những toán quân A-ram đi cướp phá đã bắt một cô gái nhỏ từ xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên, và cô hầu hạ vợ Na-a-man.
vi.R: Trước đó, quân lính A-ram đã đi đánh cướp trong xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ bắt được một cô bé, và cô trở thành người hầu của vợ Na-a-man.

ko.L: 그리고 아람이 약탈대로 나가서 이스라엘 땅에서 어린 소녀 하나를 사로잡아 왔는데, 그 소녀가 나아만의 아내 앞에 있었다.
ko.B: 아람의 약탈대가 나가서 이스라엘 땅에서 어린 소녀 하나를 사로잡아 왔는데, 그 소녀는 나아만의 아내의 시중을 들었다.
ko.R: 얼마 전에 아람 군인들이 이스라엘 땅에 쳐들어가서 물건과 사람을 빼앗아 온 일이 있었다. 그때 그들이 어린 소녀 하나를 붙잡아 왔는데, 그 소녀는 나아만의 아내의 몸종이 되었다.

decisions.choice: raiding bands: small armed groups that crossed the border to plunder and take captives
decisions.reason: Raids like these went on even when there was no full war between the kingdoms (6:23; 13:20-21). Captives were taken back to serve in their captors' households.

decisions.choice: she was before Naaman's wife: she served her as an attendant
decisions.reason: To be or stand "before" someone is to wait on that person (1 Kings 1:2; 10:8). The girl, taken from her home, became a servant in the commander's household.

decisions.choice: Some time before; soldiers from Aram
decisions.reason: Readable shows that the raid happened before the story begins, which the Hebrew marks with the verb form, and names the raiders as soldiers.

source.text: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־גְּבִרְתָּ֔הּ אַחֲלֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י לִפְנֵ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן אָ֛ז יֶאֱסֹ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ מִצָּרַעְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And she said to her mistress, Would that my master [were] before the prophet who [is] in Samaria! Then he would gather him from his scale disease.

en.L: And she said to her mistress, "If only my master [were] before the prophet who [is] in Samaria! Then he would gather him from his scale disease."
en.B: She said to her mistress, "If only my master could stand before the prophet in Samaria! Then he would free him from his skin disease."
en.R: She said to her mistress, "I wish my master would go to see the prophet who lives in Samaria. He would heal him of his skin disease."

es.L: Y ella dijo a su señora: «¡Ojalá mi señor [estuviera] delante del profeta que [está] en Samaria! Entonces lo recogería de su enfermedad de la piel».
es.B: Ella le dijo a su señora: «¡Ojalá mi señor se presentara ante el profeta que está en Samaria! Él lo libraría de su enfermedad de la piel».
es.R: Ella le dijo a su señora: «Me gustaría que mi amo fuera a ver al profeta que vive en Samaria. Él lo sanaría de su enfermedad de la piel».

fr.L: Et elle dit à sa maîtresse : « Ah, si mon maître [était] devant le prophète qui [est] à Samarie ! Alors il le délivrerait de sa maladie de la peau. »
fr.B: Elle dit à sa maîtresse : « Si seulement mon maître pouvait se présenter devant le prophète qui est à Samarie ! Il le délivrerait de sa maladie de peau. »
fr.R: Elle a dit à sa maîtresse : « J’aimerais tant que mon maître aille voir le prophète qui habite à Samarie. Il le guérirait de sa maladie de peau. »

sw.L: Akamwambia bibi yake, "Laiti bwana wangu [angekuwa] mbele ya nabii aliye Samaria! Ndipo angemkusanya kutoka katika ugonjwa wake wa ngozi."
sw.B: Akamwambia bibi yake, "Laiti bwana wangu angesimama mbele ya nabii aliye Samaria! Angemwondolea ugonjwa wake wa ngozi."
sw.R: Akamwambia bibi yake, "Laiti bwana wangu angekwenda kumwona nabii anayeishi Samaria. Angemponya ugonjwa wake wa ngozi."

vi.L: Cô nói với bà chủ mình: "Ước gì chủ tôi [được] đến trước mặt nhà tiên tri ở Sa-ma-ri! Thì người ấy sẽ thâu nhận ông lại khỏi bệnh phung."
vi.B: Cô nói với bà chủ: "Ước gì ông chủ con được đến gặp nhà tiên tri ở Sa-ma-ri! Người ấy sẽ giải thoát ông khỏi bệnh ngoài da."
vi.R: Cô nói với bà chủ: "Ước gì ông chủ con đến gặp nhà tiên tri ở Sa-ma-ri. Người ấy sẽ chữa cho ông khỏi bệnh ngoài da."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 자기 여주인에게 말했다. "우리 주인께서 사마리아에 있는 예언자 앞에 [계시면] 좋겠습니다! 그러면 그가 그분을 그 악성 피부병에서 거두어 줄 텐데요."
ko.B: 그 소녀가 여주인에게 말했다. "주인님께서 사마리아에 있는 예언자 앞에 가 보시면 좋겠습니다! 그러면 그 예언자가 주인님의 피부병을 고쳐 줄 텐데요."
ko.R: 그 소녀가 여주인에게 말했다. "주인님께서 사마리아에 사는 예언자를 만나러 가시면 좋겠어요. 그 예언자가 주인님의 피부병을 고쳐 줄 거예요."

decisions.choice: gather him from his scale disease: free him from it, so that he can be received back among people
decisions.reason: The verb means "gather" or "take in". In Numbers 12:14-15 Miriam is "gathered in" to the camp after her skin disease; here the same verb is used of curing the disease, perhaps because healing let a person be taken back into the community. It is used this way again in verses 6, 7 and 11.

decisions.choice: the prophet in Samaria: Elisha
decisions.reason: Elisha had gone to Samaria, the capital of the northern kingdom, after Elijah was taken up (2:25), and he has a house there (verse 9). The girl knows of him from home.

decisions.choice: if only: a wish
decisions.reason: The word expresses a strong wish (Psalm 119:5). The girl speaks with confidence: if Naaman reaches the prophet, he will be healed.

decisions.choice: gather him from
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb so that the reader can see the picture behind it; Balanced and Readable say "cure" and "heal".

decisions.choice: lo recogería de
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb "gather", the picture of a sick man received back among people (m1); Balanced says "libraría" and Readable "sanaría".

decisions.choice: "thâu nhận ông lại khỏi"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "gather", which pictures the sick man received back among people (m1); Balanced and Readable say free and heal.

decisions.choice: "거두어 주다" at Literal for "gather him from"
decisions.reason: As the English Literal keeps "gather", the Korean Literal keeps the picture of being taken back in among people (m1); Balanced and Readable say "heal".

decisions.choice: The girl speaks to her mistress in 합쇼체 (L, B) and 해요체 (R), and gives Naaman the honorific
decisions.reason: A young servant girl speaks to her mistress with respect; Readable's 해요체 suits a child's voice.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לַאדֹנָ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּזֹ֤את וְכָזֹאת֙ דִּבְּרָ֣ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵאֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went and told his master, saying, Like this and like this spoke the girl who [is] from [the] land of Israel.

en.L: And he went in and told his master, saying, "Like this and like this the girl who [is] from the land of Israel has spoken."
en.B: Naaman went in and told his master, "This is what the girl from the land of Israel said."
en.R: Naaman went to the king and told him what the girl from Israel had said.

es.L: Y él entró y se lo contó a su señor, diciendo: «Así y así ha dicho la muchacha que [es] de la tierra de Israel».
es.B: Naamán fue a contárselo a su señor: «Esto es lo que dijo la muchacha de la tierra de Israel».
es.R: Naamán fue a ver al rey y le contó lo que había dicho la muchacha de Israel.

fr.L: Et il alla le raconter à son maître, en disant : « Ainsi et ainsi a parlé la jeune fille qui [est] du pays d’Israël. »
fr.B: Naaman alla le dire à son maître : « Voici ce qu’a dit la jeune fille du pays d’Israël. »
fr.R: Naaman est allé voir le roi et lui a raconté ce que la jeune fille d’Israël avait dit.

sw.L: Akaingia, akamweleza bwana wake, akisema, "Hivi na hivi ndivyo alivyosema msichana aliyetoka nchi ya Israeli."
sw.B: Naamani akaingia, akamweleza bwana wake, "Hivi ndivyo alivyosema yule msichana kutoka nchi ya Israeli."
sw.R: Naamani akaenda kwa mfalme, akamweleza yale aliyosema yule msichana kutoka Israeli.

vi.L: Ông đi vào thuật cho chủ mình: "Cô gái từ xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên đã nói thế này thế này."
vi.B: Na-a-man vào tâu với chủ mình: "Cô gái từ xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên đã nói như thế này."
vi.R: Na-a-man đến gặp vua và kể lại những gì cô gái từ Y-sơ-ra-ên đã nói.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 들어가서 자기 주인에게 알려 말했다. "이스라엘 땅에서 온 소녀가 이러이러하게 말했습니다."
ko.B: 나아만이 들어가서 자기 주인에게 말했다. "이스라엘 땅에서 온 소녀가 이렇게 말했습니다."
ko.R: 나아만은 왕에게 가서 이스라엘에서 온 소녀가 한 말을 전했다.

decisions.choice: he: Naaman; his master: the king of Aram
decisions.reason: The verse does not name either man, but the next verse shows that Naaman reported to the king.

decisions.choice: like this and like this: such and such, a summary of what was said
decisions.reason: The phrase stands for words already given, so the story does not repeat them (1 Kings 14:5).

decisions.choice: told him what the girl from Israel had said
decisions.reason: Readable gives the report as reported speech, since the words were given in verse 3, and names the master as the king.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָם֙ לֶךְ־בֹּ֔א וְאֶשְׁלְחָ֥ה סֵ֖פֶר אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ וַיִּקַּ֨ח בְּיָד֜וֹ עֶ֣שֶׂר כִּכְּרֵי־כֶ֗סֶף וְשֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ זָהָ֔ב וְעֶ֖שֶׂר חֲלִיפ֥וֹת בְּגָדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] king of Aram, Go, come, and I will send a letter to [the] king of Israel. And he went and took in his hand ten talents of silver and six thousand [of] gold and ten changes of garments.

en.L: And the king of Aram said, "Go, come, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel." And he went and took in his hand ten talents of silver and 6,000 [shekels] of gold and ten changes of clothes.
en.B: The king of Aram said, "Go at once, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So Naaman went, taking with him {{units:about 750 pounds of silver|ten talents of silver}}, {{units:about 150 pounds of gold|6,000 shekels of gold}} and ten sets of fine clothes.
en.R: The king of Aram said, "Go now. I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So Naaman set out. He took with him {{units:about 750 pounds of silver|ten talents of silver}}, {{units:about 150 pounds of gold|6,000 shekels of gold}} and ten sets of fine clothes.

es.L: Y dijo el rey de Aram: «Anda, ve, y yo enviaré una carta al rey de Israel». Y él fue y tomó en su mano diez talentos de plata, seis mil [siclos] de oro y diez mudas de ropa.
es.B: El rey de Aram le dijo: «Ve enseguida, y yo enviaré una carta al rey de Israel». Así que Naamán partió, llevando consigo {{units:unos 340 kilos de plata|diez talentos de plata}}, {{units:unos 69 kilos de oro|seis mil siclos de oro}} y diez mudas de ropa fina.
es.R: El rey de Aram le dijo: «Ve ahora. Yo le enviaré una carta al rey de Israel». Así que Naamán se puso en camino. Llevó consigo {{units:unos 340 kilos de plata|diez talentos de plata}}, {{units:unos 69 kilos de oro|seis mil siclos de oro}} y diez mudas de ropa fina.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Aram dit : « Va, pars, et j’enverrai une lettre au roi d’Israël. » Et il partit et prit dans sa main dix talents d’argent, six mille [sicles] d’or et dix vêtements de rechange.
fr.B: Le roi d’Aram dit : « Pars tout de suite, et j’enverrai une lettre au roi d’Israël. » Naaman partit donc, en emportant {{units:environ 340 kg d’argent|dix talents d’argent}}, {{units:environ 69 kg d’or|six mille sicles d’or}} et dix vêtements de fête.
fr.R: Le roi d’Aram a dit : « Pars maintenant. J’enverrai une lettre au roi d’Israël. » Naaman s’est donc mis en route. Il a emporté {{units:environ 340 kg d’argent|dix talents d’argent}}, {{units:environ 69 kg d’or|six mille sicles d’or}} et dix vêtements de fête.

sw.L: Mfalme wa Aramu akasema, "Nenda, uende, nami nitampelekea mfalme wa Israeli barua." Akaenda, akachukua mkononi mwake talanta kumi za fedha, na [shekeli] 6,000 za dhahabu, na mavazi kumi ya kubadili.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Aramu akasema, "Nenda sasa hivi, nami nitampelekea mfalme wa Israeli barua." Basi Naamani akaondoka, akachukua pamoja naye {{units:karibu kilo 340 za fedha|talanta kumi za fedha}}, {{units:karibu kilo 69 za dhahabu|shekeli 6,000 za dhahabu}} na mavazi kumi ya fahari.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Aramu akasema, "Nenda sasa. Nitampelekea mfalme wa Israeli barua." Basi Naamani akaondoka. Akachukua pamoja naye {{units:karibu kilo 340 za fedha|talanta kumi za fedha}}, {{units:karibu kilo 69 za dhahabu|shekeli 6,000 za dhahabu}} na mavazi kumi ya fahari.

vi.L: Vua A-ram nói: "Hãy đi, đi đi, và ta sẽ gửi một lá thư cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên." Ông đi và mang theo trong tay mười ta-lâng bạc, 6.000 [siếc-lơ] vàng, và mười bộ áo.
vi.B: Vua A-ram nói: "Ngươi hãy đi ngay, ta sẽ gửi một lá thư cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên." Vậy Na-a-man lên đường, đem theo {{units:khoảng 340 kg bạc|mười ta-lâng bạc}}, {{units:khoảng 69 kg vàng|6.000 siếc-lơ vàng}} và mười bộ áo quý.
vi.R: Vua A-ram nói: "Ngươi hãy đi ngay. Ta sẽ gửi một lá thư cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên." Vậy Na-a-man lên đường. Ông đem theo {{units:khoảng 340 kg bạc|mười ta-lâng bạc}}, {{units:khoảng 69 kg vàng|6.000 siếc-lơ vàng}} và mười bộ áo quý.

ko.L: 그리고 아람 왕이 말했다. "가거라, 가거라. 내가 이스라엘 왕에게 편지를 보내겠다." 그래서 그가 가면서 자기 손에 은 열 달란트와 금 6,000 [세겔]과 옷 열 벌을 가지고 갔다.
ko.B: 아람 왕이 말했다. "어서 가거라. 내가 이스라엘 왕에게 편지를 보내겠다." 그래서 나아만은 {{units:은 340킬로그램쯤과|은 열 달란트와}} {{units:금 69킬로그램쯤|금 6,000세겔}}과 좋은 옷 열 벌을 가지고 길을 떠났다.
ko.R: 아람 왕이 말했다. "어서 가 보아라. 내가 이스라엘 왕에게 편지를 써 보내겠다." 그래서 나아만은 길을 떠났다. 그는 {{units:은 340킬로그램쯤과|은 열 달란트와}} {{units:금 69킬로그램쯤|금 6,000세겔}}과 좋은 옷 열 벌을 가지고 갔다.

decisions.choice: go, come: go at once
decisions.reason: Two verbs of motion together urge the hearer to set off without delay. The king approves the plan at once.

decisions.choice: a very large gift of silver and gold
decisions.reason: A talent was about 75 pounds of metal, so ten talents of silver was a great fortune. The unit of the gold is not stated; it is most likely the shekel, the usual weight for smaller sums. A great man going to ask for healing brought gifts to match his rank (1 Kings 14:3; 2 Kings 8:8-9).

decisions.choice: changes of garments: fine sets of clothes, given as gifts
decisions.reason: These were festive clothes that a person changed into for special occasions, and they were valued gifts (Genesis 45:22; Judges 14:12-13).

decisions.choice: took in his hand: took with him
decisions.reason: "In his hand" means in his keeping, not that he held it all himself (Genesis 43:12).

decisions.choice: about 750 pounds of silver; about 150 pounds of gold (6,000 shekels)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give modern weights, with the original units as the alternative: a talent is about 75 pounds and a shekel about 2/5 of an ounce. Literal keeps the units and brackets the shekel the Hebrew leaves unstated.

decisions.choice: unos 340 kilos de plata; unos 69 kilos de oro
alternatives: diez talentos de plata; seis mil siclos de oro
decisions.reason: Metric weights by default at Balanced and Readable, with the original units as the alternative, at the terms note's values (talent 34 kg, shekel 11.5 g); Literal keeps the units.

decisions.choice: "environ 340 kg d’argent", "environ 69 kg d’or"
decisions.reason: Metric by default in French (talent 34 kg, shekel 11.5 g), the original units as the alternative, as the terms note; this differs from the English pounds.

decisions.choice: "karibu kilo 340 za fedha", "karibu kilo 69 za dhahabu"
decisions.reason: Swahili gives metric weights by default (talent 34 kg, shekel 11.5 g), with the original units as the alternative; English gives pounds. Literal keeps the units.

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 340 kg bạc|mười ta-lâng bạc}}; {{units:khoảng 69 kg vàng|6.000 siếc-lơ vàng}}
decisions.reason: Vietnamese gives metric by default, with the original units as the alternative (talent 34 kg, shekel 11,5 g), as the Samuel drafts do; Literal keeps "ta-lâng" and "siếc-lơ".

decisions.choice: "{{units:은 340킬로그램쯤|은 열 달란트}}", "{{units:금 69킬로그램쯤|금 6,000세겔}}": metric by default, the original units as the alternative; Literal keeps talents and shekels
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide and the terms note (talent 34 kg, shekel 11.5 g); Korean puts the metal inside the span, and for silver the particle too, since "쯤과" and "달란트와" differ.

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֣א הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר וְעַתָּ֗ה כְּב֨וֹא הַסֵּ֤פֶר הַזֶּה֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ אֶת־נַעֲמָ֣ן עַבְדִּ֔י וַאֲסַפְתּ֖וֹ מִצָּרַעְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought the letter to [the] king of Israel, saying, And now, when comes the letter this to you, behold, I have sent to you Naaman my servant, and you will gather him from his scale disease.

en.L: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, "And now, when this letter comes to you, look, I have sent to you Naaman my servant, and you shall gather him from his scale disease."
en.B: He brought the letter to the king of Israel. It said, "With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman to you, so that you may cure him of his skin disease."
en.R: Naaman took the letter to the king of Israel. It said, "I am sending my official Naaman to you with this letter. I want you to heal him of his skin disease."

es.L: Y llevó la carta al rey de Israel, que decía: «Y ahora, cuando te llegue esta carta, he aquí que te he enviado a Naamán, mi siervo, para que lo recojas de su enfermedad de la piel».
es.B: Llevó la carta al rey de Israel. Decía así: «Con esta carta te envío a mi siervo Naamán, para que lo sanes de su enfermedad de la piel».
es.R: Naamán le llevó la carta al rey de Israel. Decía: «Con esta carta te envío a Naamán, mi oficial. Quiero que lo sanes de su enfermedad de la piel».

fr.L: Et il apporta la lettre au roi d’Israël ; elle disait : « Et maintenant, quand cette lettre te parviendra, voici, je t’ai envoyé Naaman, mon serviteur, et tu le délivreras de sa maladie de la peau. »
fr.B: Il remit la lettre au roi d’Israël. Elle disait : « Avec cette lettre, je t’envoie mon serviteur Naaman, pour que tu le guérisses de sa maladie de peau. »
fr.R: Naaman a apporté la lettre au roi d’Israël. Elle disait : « Je t’envoie mon officier Naaman avec cette lettre. Je veux que tu le guérisses de sa maladie de peau. »

sw.L: Akaileta barua kwa mfalme wa Israeli, ikisema, "Na sasa, barua hii itakapokufikia, tazama, nimekutumia Naamani mtumishi wangu, nawe utamkusanya kutoka katika ugonjwa wake wa ngozi."
sw.B: Akaipeleka barua kwa mfalme wa Israeli. Ilisema, "Pamoja na barua hii ninakutumia mtumishi wangu Naamani, ili umwondolee ugonjwa wake wa ngozi."
sw.R: Naamani akaipeleka barua kwa mfalme wa Israeli. Ilisema, "Ninakutumia afisa wangu Naamani pamoja na barua hii. Nataka umponye ugonjwa wake wa ngozi."

vi.L: Ông đem lá thư đến cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, thư nói: "Bây giờ, khi lá thư này đến tay vua, kìa, ta đã sai Na-a-man, đầy tớ ta, đến với vua, để vua thâu nhận ông ấy lại khỏi bệnh phung."
vi.B: Ông đem lá thư đến cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Thư viết: "Cùng với lá thư này, ta sai Na-a-man, đầy tớ ta, đến với vua, để vua chữa cho ông ấy khỏi bệnh ngoài da."
vi.R: Na-a-man đem lá thư đến cho vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Thư viết: "Ta gửi lá thư này cùng với Na-a-man, quan chức của ta, đến gặp vua. Ta muốn vua chữa cho ông ấy khỏi bệnh ngoài da."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그 편지를 이스라엘 왕에게 가져갔는데, [거기에] 이렇게 [쓰여 있었다]. "이제 이 편지가 당신에게 이르면, 보시오, 내가 내 신하 나아만을 당신에게 보냈으니, 당신은 그를 그의 악성 피부병에서 거두어 주시오."
ko.B: 그는 그 편지를 이스라엘 왕에게 가져갔다. 편지에는 이렇게 쓰여 있었다. "이 편지와 함께 내 신하 나아만을 당신에게 보내니, 그의 피부병을 고쳐 주시오."
ko.R: 나아만은 그 편지를 이스라엘 왕에게 가져갔다. 편지에는 이렇게 쓰여 있었다. "이 편지를 가지고 가는 사람은 내 신하 나아만이오. 그의 피부병을 고쳐 주기 바라오."

decisions.choice: and now: the main business of the letter
decisions.reason: Letters began with greetings and then turned to their purpose with "and now" (10:2). Only the request is quoted here.

decisions.choice: my servant: Naaman as the king's high official
decisions.reason: A king's "servant" was any officer in his service, up to the highest (1 Kings 1:47). Naaman commands the army.

decisions.choice: you shall cure him: the king of Aram addresses the request to the king of Israel
decisions.reason: The girl spoke of a prophet, but the letter asks the king. A king would expect the healers and prophets of a kingdom to act at their king's command, and the request alarms the king of Israel (verse 7).

decisions.choice: my official
decisions.reason: Readable says "official" for a king's servant who holds high office, as these books do for the king's servants; Literal and Balanced keep "servant".

decisions.choice: the king of Aram writes "ta" and calls the king of Israel "vua"
decisions.reason: The stronger king writes with the royal "ta", but gives his neighbor his title.

decisions.choice: The king of Aram writes to the king of Israel in 하오체 with "당신"
decisions.reason: As kings speaking as equals (3:7); the letter's tone is a command, not a request (m3).

source.text: וַיְהִ֡י כִּקְרֹא֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת־הַסֵּ֜פֶר וַיִּקְרַ֣ע בְּגָדָ֗יו וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַאֱלֹהִ֥ים אָ֨נִי֙ לְהָמִ֣ית וּֽלְהַחֲי֔וֹת כִּֽי־זֶה֙ שֹׁלֵ֣חַ אֵלַ֔י לֶאֱסֹ֥ף אִ֖ישׁ מִצָּֽרַעְתּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י אַךְ־דְּעֽוּ־נָא֙ וּרְא֔וּ כִּֽי־מִתְאַנֶּ֥ה ה֖וּא לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when read [the] king of Israel the letter, and he tore his garments and said, [Am] God I, to kill and to make alive, that this [one] sends to me to gather a man from his scale disease? For only know, please, and see that seeking an occasion he [is] against me.

en.L: And it happened, when the king of Israel read the letter, that he tore his clothes and said, "[Am] I God, to kill and to make alive, that this [man] sends to me to gather a man from his scale disease? But only know, please, and see that he is seeking an occasion against me."
en.B: The king of Israel read the letter and at once tore his clothes. "Am I God," he said, "to put to death and to give life, that this man sends someone to me to be cured of his skin disease? Think about it and see: he is looking for a reason to quarrel with me."
en.R: The king of Israel read the letter and tore his clothes in alarm. He said, "Am I God? Can I kill people and bring them back to life? Why does this man send me someone and tell me to heal his skin disease? You can see that he is only looking for an excuse to fight me!"

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando el rey de Israel leyó la carta, rasgó sus vestidos y dijo: «¿Soy yo Dios, para matar y dar vida, que este me envía a que recoja a un hombre de su enfermedad de la piel? {{plural_you:Sepan|Sabed}}, pues, y {{plural_you:vean|ved}} que él busca ocasión contra mí».
es.B: Al leer la carta, el rey de Israel se rasgó las vestiduras y dijo: «¿Acaso soy yo Dios, para dar muerte y dar vida, que este me manda a un hombre para que lo sane de su enfermedad de la piel? {{plural_you:Fíjense|Fijaos}} bien y {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} que está buscando pretexto para pelear conmigo».
es.R: El rey de Israel leyó la carta y, alarmado, se rasgó la ropa. Dijo: «¿Acaso soy yo Dios? ¿Puedo matar a la gente y devolverle la vida? ¿Por qué este hombre me manda a alguien y me dice que lo sane de su enfermedad de la piel? ¡Ya {{plural_you:ven|veis}} que solo está buscando una excusa para pelear conmigo!».

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand le roi d’Israël eut lu la lettre, qu’il déchira ses vêtements et dit : « Suis-je Dieu, pour faire mourir et faire vivre, que celui-ci m’envoie [quelqu’un] pour délivrer un homme de sa maladie de la peau ? Sachez donc et voyez qu’il cherche une occasion contre moi. »
fr.B: Dès que le roi d’Israël eut lu la lettre, il déchira ses vêtements. « Suis-je Dieu, dit-il, pour donner la mort et la vie, que cet homme m’envoie quelqu’un à guérir de sa maladie de peau ? Réfléchissez et voyez : il cherche un prétexte pour me faire la guerre ! »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël a lu la lettre et il a déchiré ses vêtements, affolé. Il a dit : « Est-ce que je suis Dieu ? Est-ce que je peux faire mourir les gens et leur rendre la vie ? Pourquoi cet homme m’envoie-t-il quelqu’un en me demandant de guérir sa maladie de peau ? Vous voyez bien qu’il cherche seulement une excuse pour m’attaquer ! »

sw.L: Ikawa, mfalme wa Israeli alipoisoma barua, akararua mavazi yake, akasema, "Je, mimi [ni] Mungu, niue na kuhuisha, hata huyu ananitumia mtu ili nimkusanye kutoka katika ugonjwa wake wa ngozi? Lakini jueni tu, tafadhali, mwone kwamba anatafuta sababu dhidi yangu."
sw.B: Mfalme wa Israeli aliposoma barua, mara akararua mavazi yake. Akasema, "Je, mimi ni Mungu, niue na kuhuisha, hata mtu huyu ananitumia mtu ili aondolewe ugonjwa wake wa ngozi? Fikirini, mwone: anatafuta sababu ya kugombana nami."
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli aliposoma barua, alirarua mavazi yake kwa hofu. Akasema, "Je, mimi ni Mungu? Je, ninaweza kuua watu na kuwarudishia uhai? Kwa nini mtu huyu ananitumia mtu na kuniambia nimponye ugonjwa wake wa ngozi? Mnaona kwamba anatafuta tu kisingizio cha kupigana nami!"

vi.L: Khi vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đọc lá thư, vua xé áo mình và nói: "Ta có phải là Đức Chúa Trời, có quyền giết và làm cho sống, mà người này sai người đến với ta để ta thâu nhận một người lại khỏi bệnh phung sao? Các ngươi hãy biết và xem, hắn đang tìm cớ gây sự với ta."
vi.B: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đọc thư xong thì xé áo mình và nói: "Ta là Đức Chúa Trời sao mà có quyền giết và ban sự sống, để người này sai người đến cho ta chữa bệnh ngoài da? Các ngươi hãy suy nghĩ mà xem: hắn đang tìm cớ gây chiến với ta."
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đọc thư xong thì xé áo mình vì hoảng sợ. Vua nói: "Ta là Đức Chúa Trời sao? Ta có thể giết người rồi làm cho sống lại được sao? Sao người này lại sai người đến bảo ta chữa bệnh ngoài da cho? Các ngươi xem đó, hắn chỉ đang tìm cớ để đánh ta!"

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕이 그 편지를 읽고 자기 옷을 찢으며 말했다. "내가 죽이고 살리는 하나님이냐? 이 사람이 사람을 그의 악성 피부병에서 거두어 주라고 내게 보내다니! 그러니 너희는 부디 알고 보아라. 그가 내게 트집을 잡으려는 것이다."
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕은 그 편지를 읽자마자 자기 옷을 찢으며 말했다. "내가 사람을 죽이고 살리는 하나님이란 말이냐? 이 사람이 피부병을 고쳐 달라고 사람을 내게 보내다니! 생각해 보아라. 그가 나와 싸울 구실을 찾고 있는 것이다."
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕은 그 편지를 읽고 깜짝 놀라 자기 옷을 찢었다. 그가 말했다. "내가 하나님이냐? 내가 사람을 죽였다가 다시 살릴 수 있단 말이냐? 이 사람은 어째서 사람을 내게 보내면서 그 피부병을 고쳐 주라고 하느냐? 너희도 알겠지만, 그는 나와 싸울 핑계를 찾고 있을 뿐이다!"

decisions.choice: he tore his clothes: a sign of horror and distress
decisions.reason: Tearing one's clothes showed grief, alarm or despair (2 Samuel 13:19; 2 Kings 19:1). The king sees the letter as a threat he cannot meet.

decisions.choice: to kill and to make alive: power over life and death, which belongs to God alone
decisions.reason: The words recall Deuteronomy 32:39 and 1 Samuel 2:6, where God alone kills and makes alive. The king rightly knows that healing such a disease is beyond any human ruler, yet he does not think to turn to the prophet.

decisions.choice: seeking an occasion: looking for a pretext for war
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek an opportunity against someone; a related word is used in Judges 14:4. The king fears that when the cure fails, Aram will treat it as an insult and attack.

decisions.choice: the king of Israel: not named here
decisions.reason: The king is most likely Jehoram son of Ahab, who reigned in Samaria in Elisha's time (3:1). The story leaves him unnamed.

decisions.choice: in alarm; Why does this man ...
decisions.reason: Readable says what the torn clothes show and breaks the long question into three short questions.

source.text: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ׀אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּֽי־קָרַ֤ע מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר לָ֥מָּה קָרַ֖עְתָּ בְּגָדֶ֑יךָ יָבֹֽא־נָ֣א אֵלַ֔י וְיֵדַ֕ע כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ נָבִ֖יא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when heard Elisha, [the] man of the God, that had torn [the] king of Israel his garments, and he sent to the king, saying, Why have you torn your garments? Let him come, please, to me, and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel.

en.L: And it happened, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, "Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come to me, please, and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel."
en.B: Elisha the man of God learned that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, and he sent this word to the king: "Why have you torn your clothes? Let the man come to me, and he will find out that Israel has a prophet."
en.R: News reached Elisha the man of God that the king of Israel had torn his clothes. So he sent the king this message: "Why have you torn your clothes? Send the man to me. Then he will know that there is a prophet in Israel."

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Eliseo, el hombre de Dios, oyó que el rey de Israel había rasgado sus vestidos, envió a decir al rey: «¿Por qué has rasgado tus vestidos? Que venga, te ruego, a mí, y sabrá que hay profeta en Israel».
es.B: Cuando Eliseo, el hombre de Dios, se enteró de que el rey de Israel se había rasgado las vestiduras, le mandó este mensaje: «¿Por qué te has rasgado las vestiduras? Que venga ese hombre a verme, y sabrá que hay un profeta en Israel».
es.R: Eliseo, el hombre de Dios, supo que el rey de Israel se había rasgado la ropa. Entonces le mandó este mensaje al rey: «¿Por qué te rasgaste la ropa? Mándame a ese hombre. Así sabrá que hay un profeta en Israel».

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Élisée, l’homme de Dieu, apprit que le roi d’Israël avait déchiré ses vêtements, qu’il envoya dire au roi : « Pourquoi as-tu déchiré tes vêtements ? Qu’il vienne donc vers moi, et il saura qu’il y a un prophète en Israël. »
fr.B: Élisée, l’homme de Dieu, apprit que le roi d’Israël avait déchiré ses vêtements, et il envoya dire au roi : « Pourquoi as-tu déchiré tes vêtements ? Que cet homme vienne me trouver, et il saura qu’il y a un prophète en Israël. »
fr.R: Élisée, l’homme de Dieu, a appris que le roi d’Israël avait déchiré ses vêtements. Il lui a envoyé ce message : « Pourquoi as-tu déchiré tes vêtements ? Envoie-moi cet homme. Alors il saura qu’il y a un prophète en Israël. »

sw.L: Ikawa, Elisha mtu wa Mungu aliposikia kwamba mfalme wa Israeli amerarua mavazi yake, akatuma kwa mfalme, akisema, "Kwa nini umerarua mavazi yako? Tafadhali, aje kwangu, naye atajua kwamba yuko nabii katika Israeli."
sw.B: Elisha mtu wa Mungu alisikia kwamba mfalme wa Israeli amerarua mavazi yake, akampelekea mfalme ujumbe huu: "Kwa nini umerarua mavazi yako? Mtu huyo na aje kwangu, naye atatambua kwamba Israeli ina nabii."
sw.R: Habari zilimfikia Elisha mtu wa Mungu kwamba mfalme wa Israeli amerarua mavazi yake. Basi akampelekea mfalme ujumbe huu: "Kwa nini umerarua mavazi yako? Mtume mtu huyo kwangu. Ndipo atajua kwamba yuko nabii katika Israeli."

vi.L: Khi Ê-li-sê, người của Đức Chúa Trời, nghe rằng vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã xé áo mình, ông sai người đến nói với vua: "Sao vua đã xé áo mình? Xin hãy để người ấy đến với tôi, và người ấy sẽ biết rằng có một nhà tiên tri trong Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: Ê-li-sê, người của Đức Chúa Trời, nghe tin vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã xé áo mình, thì sai người đến nói với vua: "Sao vua lại xé áo mình? Hãy để người ấy đến với tôi, rồi người ấy sẽ biết rằng Y-sơ-ra-ên có một nhà tiên tri."
vi.R: Tin vua Y-sơ-ra-ên xé áo mình đến tai Ê-li-sê, người của Đức Chúa Trời. Vậy ông sai người đến nói với vua: "Sao vua lại xé áo mình? Hãy sai người ấy đến với tôi. Rồi người ấy sẽ biết rằng trong Y-sơ-ra-ên có một nhà tiên tri."

ko.L: 그리고 하나님의 사람 엘리사가 이스라엘 왕이 자기 옷을 찢었다는 것을 듣고, 왕에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "어찌하여 임금님께서 옷을 찢으셨습니까? 그를 제게 오게 하십시오. 그러면 그가 이스라엘에 예언자가 있다는 것을 알게 될 것입니다."
ko.B: 하나님의 사람 엘리사는 이스라엘 왕이 자기 옷을 찢었다는 말을 듣고 왕에게 사람을 보내어 말을 전했다. "어찌하여 옷을 찢으셨습니까? 그 사람을 제게 보내십시오. 그러면 그는 이스라엘에 예언자가 있다는 것을 알게 될 것입니다."
ko.R: 하나님의 사람 엘리사는 이스라엘 왕이 옷을 찢었다는 소식을 들었다. 그래서 그는 왕에게 이렇게 말을 전했다. "임금님, 왜 옷을 찢으셨습니까? 그 사람을 제게 보내십시오. 그러면 그는 이스라엘에 예언자가 있다는 것을 알게 될 것입니다."

decisions.choice: the man of God: a title for a prophet
decisions.reason: Elisha is called "the man of God" through these chapters (4:7, 9; 5:14-15, 20). The title marks him as one who belongs to God and speaks for him.

decisions.choice: he will know that there is a prophet in Israel
decisions.reason: The king of Israel acts as though there were no help in Israel, as Ahaziah did when he sent to a foreign god (1:3, 6). Elisha answers that Yahweh's prophet is present. The healing will lead Naaman to know more: that there is no God except in Israel (verse 15).

decisions.choice: Let the man come (Balanced); Send the man (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name "the man" for "him", since the last man mentioned is the king.

decisions.choice: Elisha's message to the king is in 합쇼체, calling him "임금님"
decisions.reason: The terms note's default for prophets speaking to kings; here Elisha offers help, without the contempt of 3:13.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א נַעֲמָ֖ן בְּסוּסָ֣יו וּבְרִכְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד פֶּֽתַח־הַבַּ֖יִת לֶאֱלִישָֽׁע׃

en.L: And Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
en.B: So Naaman came with his horses and his chariot and stopped at the door of Elisha's house.
en.R: So Naaman went with his horses and his chariot. He stopped at the door of Elisha's house.

es.L: Y vino Naamán con sus caballos y con su carro, y se detuvo a la puerta de la casa de Eliseo.
es.B: Así que Naamán fue con sus caballos y su carro, y se detuvo a la puerta de la casa de Eliseo.
es.R: Así que Naamán fue con sus caballos y su carro. Se detuvo a la puerta de la casa de Eliseo.

fr.L: Et Naaman vint avec ses chevaux et avec son char, et il s’arrêta à l’entrée de la maison d’Élisée.
fr.B: Naaman vint donc avec ses chevaux et son char, et il s’arrêta à la porte de la maison d’Élisée.
fr.R: Naaman y est donc allé avec ses chevaux et son char. Il s’est arrêté à la porte de la maison d’Élisée.

sw.L: Naamani akaja na farasi wake na gari lake, akasimama mlangoni pa nyumba ya Elisha.
sw.B: Basi Naamani akaja na farasi wake na gari lake, akasimama mlangoni pa nyumba ya Elisha.
sw.R: Basi Naamani akaenda pamoja na farasi wake na gari lake. Akasimama mlangoni pa nyumba ya Elisha.

vi.L: Na-a-man đến với ngựa và xe của mình, và đứng ở cửa nhà Ê-li-sê.
vi.B: Vậy Na-a-man đến với ngựa và xe của mình, dừng lại trước cửa nhà Ê-li-sê.
vi.R: Vậy Na-a-man đi với ngựa và xe của mình. Ông dừng lại trước cửa nhà Ê-li-sê.

ko.L: 그리고 나아만이 자기 말들과 자기 병거를 거느리고 와서 엘리사의 집 문 앞에 섰다.
ko.B: 그래서 나아만은 말들과 병거를 거느리고 와서 엘리사의 집 문 앞에 멈추어 섰다.
ko.R: 그래서 나아만은 말들과 병거를 거느리고 갔다. 그는 엘리사의 집 문 앞에 멈추어 섰다.

decisions.choice: his horses
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text read "his horse"; the margin of the text tells readers to read "his horses", which is the reading followed here. The meaning hardly changes.

decisions.choice: his chariot: the chariot he rides, with its company
decisions.reason: The word can mean one chariot or a group of chariots. Naaman later gets down from his chariot (verse 21), and he travels with a large company (verse 15).

decisions.choice: he stood at the door: a great man arriving in state, waiting to be received
decisions.reason: Naaman comes with the full show of his rank and waits outside for the prophet to come out to him. What happens next offends him (verses 10-11).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛יו אֱלִישָׁ֖ע מַלְאָ֣ךְ לֵאמֹ֑ר הָל֗וֹךְ וְרָחַצְתָּ֤ שֶֽׁבַע־פְּעָמִים֙ בַּיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְיָשֹׁ֧ב בְּשָׂרְךָ֛ לְךָ֖ וּטְהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent to him Elisha a messenger, saying, Go and you will wash seven times in the Jordan, and will return your flesh to you, and be clean.

en.L: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, "Go and wash seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will return to you, and be clean."
en.B: Elisha sent a messenger out to him to say, "Go and wash seven times in the Jordan. Your flesh will be restored, and you will be clean."
en.R: Elisha sent a messenger out to tell him, "Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan River. Then your skin will be healed, and you will be clean."

es.L: Y Eliseo le envió un mensajero, diciendo: «Ve y lávate siete veces en el Jordán, y tu carne volverá a ti, y quedarás limpio».
es.B: Eliseo le envió un mensajero a decirle: «Ve y lávate siete veces en el Jordán. Tu carne quedará restaurada, y quedarás limpio».
es.R: Eliseo le mandó un mensajero a decirle: «Ve y lávate siete veces en el río Jordán. Así tu piel sanará, y quedarás limpio».

fr.L: Et Élisée lui envoya un messager pour dire : « Va et lave-toi sept fois dans le Jourdain, et ta chair te reviendra, et sois pur. »
fr.B: Élisée lui envoya un messager pour lui dire : « Va te laver sept fois dans le Jourdain. Ta chair redeviendra saine, et tu seras pur. »
fr.R: Élisée lui a envoyé un messager pour lui dire : « Va te laver sept fois dans le Jourdain. Alors ta peau guérira, et tu seras pur. »

sw.L: Elisha akamtumia mjumbe, akisema, "Nenda ukaoge mara saba katika Yordani, nao mwili wako utakurudia, nawe uwe safi."
sw.B: Elisha akamtumia mjumbe kumwambia, "Nenda ukaoge mara saba katika Yordani. Mwili wako utarudishwa kuwa mzima, nawe utakuwa safi."
sw.R: Elisha akamtuma mjumbe kumwambia, "Nenda ukajioshe mara saba katika mto Yordani. Ndipo ngozi yako itapona, nawe utakuwa safi."

vi.L: Ê-li-sê sai một sứ giả ra nói với ông: "Hãy đi tắm bảy lần dưới sông Giô-đanh, thì thịt ông sẽ trở lại như cũ, và ông sẽ được sạch."
vi.B: Ê-li-sê sai một sứ giả ra nói với ông: "Ông hãy đi tắm bảy lần dưới sông Giô-đanh. Da thịt ông sẽ được phục hồi, và ông sẽ được sạch."
vi.R: Ê-li-sê sai một người ra nói với ông: "Ông hãy đi tắm bảy lần dưới sông Giô-đanh. Rồi da ông sẽ được lành, và ông sẽ được sạch."

ko.L: 그리고 엘리사가 사자를 그에게 보내어 말했다. "가서 요단에서 일곱 번 씻으시오. 그러면 당신의 살이 당신에게 돌아오고, 깨끗해질 것이오."
ko.B: 엘리사는 사자를 내보내어 그에게 말을 전했다. "가서 요단강에서 일곱 번 씻으시오. 그러면 당신의 살이 회복되어 깨끗해질 것이오."
ko.R: 엘리사는 사람을 내보내어 나아만에게 말을 전했다. "요단강에 가서 몸을 일곱 번 씻으시오. 그러면 당신의 피부가 나아서 깨끗해질 것이오."

decisions.choice: Elisha sent a messenger: he did not come out to meet Naaman
decisions.reason: A man of Naaman's rank expected the prophet to come out and receive him in person. Elisha gives the word through a messenger, so that the healing will rest on Yahweh's word alone and not on the prophet's presence, and Naaman takes offense (verse 11).

decisions.choice: seven times: a complete washing
decisions.reason: Seven marks completeness. The cleansing of a person healed of skin disease also uses seven: the priest sprinkles him seven times, and he waits seven days (Leviticus 14:7-9).

decisions.choice: your flesh will return to you, and be clean: your body will be restored and you will be clean
decisions.reason: "Flesh" is the body and its skin; it will come back to health. "Be clean" is the word for cleanness in the law (Leviticus 13:6, 13); though it has the form of a command, here it is a promise of what will follow.

decisions.choice: will be restored (Balanced); your skin will be healed (Readable); you will be clean
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "will return" means, and turn the command "be clean" into the promise it is.

decisions.choice: Elisha's word calls Naaman "ông"
decisions.reason: The prophet speaks courteously to a foreign commander who has come to ask for help.

decisions.choice: Elisha's word to Naaman, sent by a messenger, is in 하오체 ("씻으시오")
decisions.reason: Elisha does not come out to the foreign commander (m1); 하오체 keeps courtesy without deference, as Elisha speaks to the Shunammite.

source.text: וַיִּקְצֹ֥ף נַעֲמָ֖ן וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ הִנֵּ֨ה אָמַ֜רְתִּי אֵלַ֣י׀יֵצֵ֣א יָצ֗וֹא וְעָמַד֙ וְקָרָא֙ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו וְהֵנִ֥יף יָד֛וֹ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם וְאָסַ֥ף הַמְּצֹרָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: And was angry Naaman and went and said, Behold, I said to myself, He will surely come out, and stand, and call on [the] name of Yahweh his God, and wave his hand over the place, and gather the scale-diseased.

en.L: But Naaman was angry and went away and said, "Look, I said to myself, 'He will surely come out to me and stand and call on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, and wave his hand over the place, and gather the one with scale disease.'
en.B: But Naaman went away angry. He said, "I thought that he would surely come out to me, stand and call on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God, wave his hand over the spot and cure me of the disease.
en.R: But Naaman became angry and went away. He said, "I was sure that he would come out to meet me. I thought he would stand there and pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God. Then he would wave his hand over the sore place and heal me of the disease.

es.L: Pero Naamán se enojó, y se fue y dijo: «He aquí, yo me decía: “Seguramente saldrá a mí, y se pondrá de pie, e invocará el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, y moverá su mano sobre el lugar y recogerá al enfermo de la piel”.
es.B: Pero Naamán se fue enojado. Decía: «Yo pensaba que sin duda saldría a recibirme, se pondría de pie, invocaría el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, movería la mano sobre la parte enferma y me sanaría de la enfermedad.
es.R: Pero Naamán se enojó y se fue. Dijo: «Yo estaba seguro de que saldría a recibirme. Pensé que se quedaría allí de pie y oraría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios. Después movería la mano sobre la parte enferma y me sanaría de la enfermedad.

fr.L: Mais Naaman s’irrita et s’en alla, et il dit : « Voici, je me disais : “Il sortira certainement vers moi, il se tiendra là, il invoquera le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu, il agitera sa main sur l’endroit et délivrera le malade.”
fr.B: Mais Naaman s’en alla en colère. Il dit : « Je pensais qu’il sortirait sûrement vers moi, qu’il se tiendrait là, qu’il invoquerait le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu, qu’il agiterait la main sur l’endroit malade et me guérirait de la maladie.
fr.R: Mais Naaman s’est mis en colère et il est parti. Il a dit : « J’étais sûr qu’il sortirait pour me recevoir. Je pensais qu’il se tiendrait là et qu’il prierait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu. Ensuite il aurait passé la main au-dessus de l’endroit malade et il m’aurait guéri de la maladie.

sw.L: Lakini Naamani akakasirika, akaenda zake, akasema, "Tazama, nilisema moyoni mwangu, 'Hakika atatoka kwangu, asimame, aliitie jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, na kupunga mkono wake juu ya mahali pale, na kumkusanya mwenye ugonjwa wa ngozi.'
sw.B: Lakini Naamani akaondoka akiwa amekasirika. Akasema, "Nilidhani kwamba hakika angetoka kwangu, asimame na kuliitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, apunge mkono wake juu ya mahali pale, na kuniondolea ugonjwa huu.
sw.R: Lakini Naamani akakasirika, akaondoka. Akasema, "Nilikuwa na hakika kwamba angetoka kunilaki. Nilidhani angesimama pale na kumwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake. Kisha angepunga mkono wake juu ya mahali penye ugonjwa na kuniponya.

vi.L: Nhưng Na-a-man nổi giận bỏ đi và nói: "Kìa, ta đã tự nhủ: 'Chắc chắn ông ấy sẽ đi ra gặp ta, đứng và kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông ấy, đưa tay qua lại trên chỗ bệnh, và thâu nhận người bệnh phung lại.'
vi.B: Nhưng Na-a-man nổi giận bỏ đi. Ông nói: "Ta tưởng ông ấy chắc chắn sẽ ra gặp ta, đứng kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông ấy, đưa tay qua lại trên chỗ bệnh và chữa cho ta khỏi bệnh.
vi.R: Nhưng Na-a-man nổi giận bỏ đi. Ông nói: "Ta cứ tưởng ông ấy sẽ ra gặp ta. Ta nghĩ ông ấy sẽ đứng đó cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông ấy. Rồi ông ấy sẽ đưa tay qua lại trên chỗ đau và chữa cho ta khỏi bệnh.

ko.L: 그러나 나아만이 화가 나서 가며 말했다. "보라, 나는 '그가 반드시 내게 나와서, 서서 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르고, 그 자리 위에 그의 손을 흔들어 악성 피부병 든 사람을 거두어 주리라' 하고 생각했다.
ko.B: 그러나 나아만은 화가 나서 돌아가며 말했다. "나는 그가 틀림없이 내게 나와서, 서서 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르고, 병든 자리 위에 손을 흔들어 이 병을 고쳐 주리라고 생각했다.
ko.R: 그러나 나아만은 화가 나서 그곳을 떠났다. 그가 말했다. "나는 그가 틀림없이 나와서 나를 맞이할 줄 알았다. 그가 서서 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도할 줄 알았다. 그리고 아픈 곳 위에 손을 흔들어서 이 병을 고쳐 줄 줄 알았다.

decisions.choice: he will surely come out: what Naaman had taken for granted
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. "I said to myself" means "I thought". Naaman had pictured a public healing worthy of his rank.

decisions.choice: wave his hand over the place: a healer's gesture over the diseased spot
decisions.reason: Naaman expected the prophet to pray aloud and move his hand over the sore part of the body. Instead he was told only to wash in a river.

decisions.choice: gather the one with scale disease: cure Naaman himself
decisions.reason: The last word means "the one with scale disease", that is, Naaman. Some take it as the diseased part of the skin; either way the sense is that the prophet would cure him.

decisions.choice: call on the name of Yahweh: pray to Yahweh, naming him
decisions.reason: To call on someone's name is to address that god in prayer (1 Kings 18:24).

decisions.choice: I thought that he would ... (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give Naaman's thought as reported speech instead of a quotation inside his speech, and say "cure me" for "the one with scale disease". Readable says "pray to" for "call on the name of". The speech continues into verse 12, so the quotation closes there.

source.text: הֲלֹ֡א טוֹב֩ אֲמָנָ֨ה וּפַרְפַּ֜ר נַהֲר֣וֹת דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק מִכֹּל֙ מֵימֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲלֹֽא־אֶרְחַ֥ץ בָּהֶ֖ם וְטָהָ֑רְתִּי וַיִּ֖פֶן וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּחֵמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [Are] not better Abana and Pharpar, [the] rivers of Damascus, than all [the] waters of Israel? Could not I wash in them and be clean? And he turned and went in a rage.

en.L: [Are] not Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not wash in them and be clean?" And he turned and went away in a rage.
en.B: Are not the rivers of Damascus, Abana and Pharpar, better than any of the waters of Israel? Could I not wash in them and be made clean?" Then he turned and went off in a fury.
en.R: The Abana and the Pharpar are the rivers of Damascus. They are better than all the waters in Israel! Why could I not wash in them and become clean?" So he turned and left in a rage.

es.L: ¿No [son] el Abana y el Farfar, ríos de Damasco, mejores que todas las aguas de Israel? ¿No podría lavarme en ellos y quedar limpio?». Y se volvió y se fue con furor.
es.B: ¿No son los ríos de Damasco, el Abana y el Farfar, mejores que todas las aguas de Israel? ¿No podría lavarme en ellos y quedar limpio?». Y dando media vuelta se fue furioso.
es.R: El Abana y el Farfar son los ríos de Damasco. ¡Son mejores que todas las aguas de Israel! ¿Por qué no podía lavarme en ellos y quedar limpio?». Así que dio media vuelta y se fue furioso.

fr.L: L’Abana et le Parpar, les fleuves de Damas, ne [sont-ils] pas meilleurs que toutes les eaux d’Israël ? Ne pourrais-je pas m’y laver et être pur ? » Et il se détourna et s’en alla en fureur.
fr.B: Les fleuves de Damas, l’Abana et le Parpar, ne valent-ils pas mieux que toutes les eaux d’Israël ? Ne pourrais-je pas m’y laver et devenir pur ? » Et il se détourna et partit furieux.
fr.R: L’Abana et le Parpar sont les fleuves de Damas. Ils sont meilleurs que toutes les eaux d’Israël ! Pourquoi est-ce que je ne pourrais pas m’y laver et devenir pur ? » Alors il a fait demi-tour et il est parti, furieux.

sw.L: Je, Abana na Farpari, mito ya Dameski, [si] bora kuliko maji yote ya Israeli? Je, nisingeweza kuoga humo nikawa safi?" Akageuka, akaenda zake kwa hasira kali.
sw.B: Je, mito ya Dameski, Abana na Farpari, si bora kuliko maji yoyote ya Israeli? Je, nisingeweza kuoga humo nikatakaswa?" Kisha akageuka, akaondoka kwa ghadhabu.
sw.R: Abana na Farpari ni mito ya Dameski. Ni bora kuliko maji yote ya Israeli! Kwa nini nisingeoga humo na kuwa safi?" Basi akageuka, akaondoka kwa hasira kali.

vi.L: Chẳng phải A-ba-na và Bạt-ba, các sông của Đa-mách, tốt hơn tất cả các dòng nước của Y-sơ-ra-ên sao? Ta há không thể tắm ở đó mà được sạch sao?" Rồi ông quay đi trong cơn giận dữ.
vi.B: Các sông của Đa-mách là A-ba-na và Bạt-ba chẳng tốt hơn mọi dòng nước của Y-sơ-ra-ên sao? Ta không thể tắm ở đó mà được sạch sao?" Rồi ông quay đi, giận dữ vô cùng.
vi.R: A-ba-na và Bạt-ba là các sông của Đa-mách. Chúng tốt hơn tất cả các dòng nước của Y-sơ-ra-ên! Sao ta không tắm ở đó mà được sạch?" Rồi ông giận dữ quay đi.

ko.L: 다메섹의 강 아바나와 바르발이 이스라엘의 모든 물보다 낫지 않으냐? 내가 거기서 씻고 깨끗해질 수 없겠느냐?" 그리고 그가 돌아서서 분노하며 갔다.
ko.B: 다메섹의 강인 아바나와 바르발이 이스라엘의 어떤 물보다도 낫지 않으냐? 거기서 씻으면 내가 깨끗해질 수 없겠느냐?" 그러고는 몹시 화를 내며 발길을 돌려 가 버렸다.
ko.R: 다메섹에는 아바나 강과 바르발 강이 있다. 그 강들이 이스라엘의 어떤 물보다 더 좋다! 그런데 왜 내가 거기서 씻고 깨끗해질 수 없단 말이냐?" 그는 몹시 화를 내며 돌아서서 가 버렸다.

decisions.choice: Abana
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text spell "Abana"; the margin of the text tells readers to say "Amana", a name also found for a mountain in Song of Songs 4:8. Both forms name the same river, and the written form is kept here.

decisions.choice: Abana and Pharpar: rivers of Damascus
decisions.reason: Rivers fed by the snow of the mountains west of Damascus watered the city and its gardens. Their clear water seemed far better to Naaman than the muddy Jordan.

decisions.choice: two questions expecting the answer "yes"
decisions.reason: Naaman's questions mean: the rivers of Damascus are better, and he could have washed in them at home. He sees no reason why Israel's river should heal him.

decisions.choice: statement for the first question
decisions.reason: Readable turns the first question into a statement, since its answer is plain.

decisions.choice: "A-ba-na và Bạt-ba"
decisions.reason: The rivers of Damascus in the usual Vietnamese forms.

decisions.choice: "다메섹", "아바나", "바르발" for Damascus, Abana and Pharpar
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant forms; "다메섹" as Acts 9 and the Samuel drafts.

source.text: וַיִּגְּשׁ֣וּ עֲבָדָיו֮ וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָיו֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אָבִי֙ דָּבָ֣ר גָּד֗וֹל הַנָּבִ֛יא דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ הֲל֣וֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְאַ֛ף כִּֽי־אָמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ רְחַ֥ץ וּטְהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And came near his servants and spoke to him and said, My father, [a] thing great [if] the prophet had spoken to you, would you not do [it]? And how much more when he has said to you, Wash and be clean.

en.L: And his servants came near and spoke to him and said, "My father, [if] the prophet had spoken a great thing to you, would you not have done [it]? How much more, then, when he has said to you, 'Wash and be clean'!"
en.B: His servants came up to him and said, "My father, had the prophet asked you to do something great, would you not have done it? How much more, then, should you obey when he tells you only, 'Wash and be clean'!"
en.R: Naaman's servants came to him and said, "Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something hard, you would have done it. So surely you can do it when he tells you only, 'Wash and be clean!'"

es.L: Y se acercaron sus siervos y le hablaron y dijeron: «Padre mío, [si] el profeta te hubiera dicho una gran cosa, ¿no la habrías hecho? ¡Cuánto más, cuando te ha dicho: “Lávate y quedarás limpio”!».
es.B: Sus siervos se le acercaron y le dijeron: «Padre mío, si el profeta te hubiera pedido algo grande, ¿no lo habrías hecho? ¡Con cuánta más razón debes obedecer cuando solo te dice: “Lávate y quedarás limpio”!».
es.R: Los siervos de Naamán se le acercaron y le dijeron: «Señor, si el profeta te hubiera mandado hacer algo difícil, lo habrías hecho. Así que con más razón puedes hacerlo cuando solo te dice: “¡Lávate y quedarás limpio!”».

fr.L: Et ses serviteurs s’approchèrent, lui parlèrent et dirent : « Mon père, [si] le prophète t’avait dit une grande chose, ne l’aurais-tu pas faite ? Combien plus quand il t’a dit : “Lave-toi et sois pur” ! »
fr.B: Ses serviteurs s’approchèrent et lui dirent : « Mon père, si le prophète t’avait demandé quelque chose de grand, ne l’aurais-tu pas fait ? À plus forte raison quand il te dit seulement : “Lave-toi et tu seras pur” ! »
fr.R: Les serviteurs de Naaman sont venus lui dire : « Maître, si le prophète t’avait demandé quelque chose de difficile, tu l’aurais fait. Alors tu peux bien le faire quand il te dit seulement : “Lave-toi, et tu seras pur !” »

sw.L: Watumishi wake wakakaribia, wakasema naye, wakasema, "Baba yangu, [kama] nabii angekuambia jambo kubwa, je, usingelifanya? Basi zaidi sana, akikuambia, 'Oga uwe safi'!"
sw.B: Watumishi wake wakamkaribia, wakasema, "Baba yangu, kama nabii angekuambia ufanye jambo kubwa, je, usingelifanya? Basi zaidi sana sasa, anapokuambia tu, 'Oga uwe safi'!"
sw.R: Watumishi wa Naamani wakamjia, wakasema, "Bwana, kama nabii angekuambia ufanye jambo gumu, ungelifanya. Basi hakika unaweza kufanya hili, anapokuambia tu, 'Oga uwe safi!'"

vi.L: Các đầy tớ của ông đến gần nói với ông: "Thưa cha, nếu nhà tiên tri bảo cha làm một việc lớn, cha lại không làm sao? Huống chi người chỉ bảo cha: 'Hãy tắm thì được sạch'!"
vi.B: Các đầy tớ của ông đến gần thưa: "Thưa cha, nếu nhà tiên tri có bảo cha làm một việc lớn lao, chẳng lẽ cha lại không làm sao? Huống chi người chỉ bảo cha: 'Hãy tắm thì được sạch'!"
vi.R: Các đầy tớ của Na-a-man đến nói với ông: "Thưa ông, nếu nhà tiên tri bảo ông làm một việc khó, chắc chắn ông đã làm rồi. Vậy khi người chỉ bảo ông: 'Hãy tắm thì được sạch', thì ông càng nên làm theo!"

ko.L: 그리고 그의 종들이 다가와서 그에게 말했다. "내 아버지여, 예언자가 장군님께 큰일을 말했더라도 하지 않으셨겠습니까? 하물며 그가 장군님께 '씻고 깨끗해지시오' 하고 말했는데야 [더욱 그렇지 않습니까]?"
ko.B: 그의 종들이 다가와서 말했다. "아버님, 예언자가 장군님께 어려운 일을 하라고 했더라도 하지 않으셨겠습니까? 하물며 '씻고 깨끗해지시오' 하고 말했을 뿐인데, 그 말을 따르셔야 하지 않겠습니까?"
ko.R: 나아만의 종들이 다가와서 말했다. "주인님, 예언자가 어려운 일을 하라고 했어도 주인님은 그 일을 하셨을 것입니다. 그런데 그는 그저 '씻고 깨끗해지시오' 하고 말했을 뿐입니다. 그러니 그렇게 하셔야 하지 않겠습니까?"

decisions.choice: my father: a respectful way to address a master
decisions.reason: The servants speak to Naaman as "father", a word of respect and affection for a superior (2 Kings 6:21; 13:14). The same letters could be read as a particle meaning "if", which gives "if the prophet had told you" with no address; the sense of the servants' argument is the same.

decisions.choice: how much more: an argument from the greater to the lesser
decisions.reason: If Naaman would have done something hard, he should all the more do something easy.

decisions.choice: his servants: the officers and attendants traveling with Naaman
decisions.reason: A commander's servants were men in his service, not owned slaves; they speak to him with respect and wisdom.

decisions.choice: Sir; something hard
decisions.reason: Readable says "Sir" for the respectful "my father", which sounds odd from servants in modern English, and "something hard" for "a great thing", that is, a great or difficult task.

decisions.choice: Padre mío (Literal, Balanced); Señor (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Padre mío" keeps the respectful address at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "Señor", since servants calling their master "father" is not usual Spanish.

decisions.choice: "Bwana" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Servants calling their master "my father" is kept at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the ordinary respectful "Bwana", as the English says "Sir".

decisions.choice: "Thưa cha" (L, B); "Thưa ông" (R)
decisions.reason: "My father" is a respectful way for servants to address their master (m1); Literal and Balanced keep the word, as the English does, and Readable gives the plain polite address.

decisions.choice: "내 아버지여" (L), "아버님" (B), "주인님" (R) for "My father", with "장군님" for "you"
decisions.reason: The servants use a respectful title for their master (m1); Balanced keeps the family word in its polite form, and Readable says "master", as the English Readable says "Sir". "장군님" avoids "당신", which a servant would not say to his master.

source.text: וַיֵּ֗רֶד וַיִּטְבֹּ֤ל בַּיַּרְדֵּן֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים כִּדְבַ֖ר אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיָּ֣שָׁב בְּשָׂר֗וֹ כִּבְשַׂ֛ר נַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן וַיִּטְהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went down and dipped in the Jordan seven times, according to [the] word of the man of the God; and returned his flesh like [the] flesh of a boy young, and he was clean.

en.L: And he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, according to the word of the man of God; and his flesh returned like the flesh of a young boy, and he was clean.
en.B: So he went down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, as the man of God had said. His flesh was restored and became like the flesh of a young boy, and he was clean.
en.R: So Naaman went down to the Jordan River and dipped himself in it seven times, as the man of God had told him. His skin became healthy again, like the skin of a young boy. He was clean!

es.L: Y descendió y se sumergió siete veces en el Jordán, conforme a la palabra del hombre de Dios; y su carne volvió como la carne de un niño pequeño, y quedó limpio.
es.B: Entonces bajó y se sumergió siete veces en el Jordán, como el hombre de Dios le había dicho. Su carne quedó restaurada y se volvió como la carne de un niño pequeño, y quedó limpio.
es.R: Así que Naamán bajó al río Jordán y se sumergió en él siete veces, tal como el hombre de Dios le había dicho. Su piel volvió a estar sana, como la piel de un niño pequeño. ¡Quedó limpio!

fr.L: Et il descendit et se plongea sept fois dans le Jourdain, selon la parole de l’homme de Dieu ; et sa chair redevint comme la chair d’un petit garçon, et il fut pur.
fr.B: Il descendit donc et se plongea sept fois dans le Jourdain, comme l’avait dit l’homme de Dieu. Sa chair redevint comme la chair d’un petit garçon, et il fut pur.
fr.R: Naaman est donc descendu au Jourdain et il s’y est plongé sept fois, comme l’homme de Dieu le lui avait dit. Sa peau est redevenue saine, comme la peau d’un petit garçon. Il était pur !

sw.L: Akashuka, akajichovya mara saba katika Yordani, sawasawa na neno la mtu wa Mungu; nao mwili wake ukarudi kama mwili wa mvulana mdogo, akawa safi.
sw.B: Basi akashuka, akajichovya mara saba katika Yordani, kama mtu wa Mungu alivyosema. Mwili wake ukarudishwa ukawa kama mwili wa mvulana mdogo, naye akawa safi.
sw.R: Basi Naamani akashuka mpaka mto Yordani, akajichovya ndani yake mara saba, kama mtu wa Mungu alivyomwambia. Ngozi yake ikapona tena, ikawa kama ngozi ya mvulana mdogo. Akawa safi!

vi.L: Vậy ông đi xuống và dìm mình bảy lần dưới sông Giô-đanh, theo lời người của Đức Chúa Trời; và thịt ông trở lại như thịt của một cậu bé, và ông được sạch.
vi.B: Vậy ông đi xuống, dìm mình bảy lần dưới sông Giô-đanh, đúng như lời người của Đức Chúa Trời. Da thịt ông được phục hồi, trở nên như da thịt của một cậu bé, và ông được sạch.
vi.R: Vậy Na-a-man xuống sông Giô-đanh và dìm mình xuống nước bảy lần, như người của Đức Chúa Trời đã bảo. Da ông lành lặn trở lại, như da của một cậu bé. Ông đã được sạch!

ko.L: 그리고 그가 내려가서 하나님의 사람의 말대로 요단에 일곱 번 몸을 담갔다. 그러자 그의 살이 어린 소년의 살처럼 돌아왔고, 그가 깨끗해졌다.
ko.B: 그래서 나아만은 내려가서 하나님의 사람이 말한 대로 요단강에 일곱 번 몸을 담갔다. 그러자 그의 살이 회복되어 어린아이의 살처럼 되었고, 그는 깨끗해졌다.
ko.R: 그래서 나아만은 요단강으로 내려가 하나님의 사람이 말한 대로 강물에 일곱 번 몸을 담갔다. 그러자 그의 피부가 어린아이의 피부처럼 다시 깨끗해졌다. 그는 깨끗하게 나았다!

decisions.choice: dipped himself: went under the water
decisions.reason: The verb means to dip or plunge (Genesis 37:31; Leviticus 14:6). Naaman went fully into the river, seven times as he was told.

decisions.choice: a young boy: an echo of the young girl of verse 2
decisions.reason: The words for "young boy" match those used of the captive girl in verse 2. Through the word of a young girl, the great commander's flesh becomes like a young boy's.

decisions.choice: according to the word of the man of God ... and he was clean
decisions.reason: The healing comes exactly as the prophet said (verse 10). The writer stresses that it was Yahweh's word, spoken through Elisha, that cleansed him, not the river.

decisions.choice: his flesh was restored (Balanced); his skin became healthy again (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 10, Balanced and Readable say what "his flesh returned" means. Readable speaks of the skin, where the disease showed.

source.text: וַיָּשָׁב֩ אֶל־אִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים ה֣וּא וְכָֽל־מַחֲנֵ֗הוּ וַיָּבֹא֮ וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָיו֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה־נָ֤א יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּכָל־הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֖י אִם־בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּ֛ה קַח־נָ֥א בְרָכָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ת עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he returned to [the] man of the God, he and all his camp, and came and stood before him and said, Behold, please, I know that there is no God in all the earth except in Israel. And now take, please, a blessing from your servant.

en.L: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his camp, and came and stood before him and said, "Look, now I know that there is no God in all the earth except in Israel. And now, please take a blessing from your servant."
en.B: Then he went back to the man of God with all his company. He came and stood before him and said, "Now I know that in all the earth there is no God except in Israel. So now, please accept a gift from your servant."
en.R: Then Naaman went back to the man of God, along with all his people. He stood in front of Elisha and said, "Now I know that there is no God anywhere in the world except in Israel. Please accept a gift from me."

es.L: Y volvió al hombre de Dios, él y todo su campamento, y llegó y se puso delante de él y dijo: «He aquí, ahora sé que no hay Dios en toda la tierra sino en Israel. Y ahora, te ruego que tomes un presente de tu siervo».
es.B: Luego volvió con toda su comitiva adonde estaba el hombre de Dios. Se presentó delante de él y le dijo: «Ahora sé que no hay Dios en toda la tierra sino en Israel. Así que, te ruego, acepta un regalo de tu siervo».
es.R: Después Naamán volvió con toda su gente adonde estaba el hombre de Dios. Se puso delante de Eliseo y le dijo: «Ahora sé que no hay Dios en ninguna parte del mundo, sino solo en Israel. Por favor, acepta un regalo de mi parte».

fr.L: Et il retourna vers l’homme de Dieu, lui et tout son camp, et il vint se tenir devant lui et dit : « Voici, je sais qu’il n’y a pas de Dieu sur toute la terre, si ce n’est en Israël. Et maintenant, accepte, je te prie, une bénédiction de ton serviteur. »
fr.B: Puis il retourna vers l’homme de Dieu avec toute sa suite. Il vint se tenir devant lui et dit : « Maintenant je sais qu’il n’y a pas de Dieu sur toute la terre, si ce n’est en Israël. Accepte donc, je te prie, un présent de ton serviteur. »
fr.R: Ensuite Naaman est retourné chez l’homme de Dieu, avec tous ses gens. Il s’est présenté devant Élisée et il a dit : « Maintenant je sais qu’il n’y a pas de Dieu dans le monde entier, sauf en Israël. S’il te plaît, accepte un cadeau de ma part. »

sw.L: Akarudi kwa mtu wa Mungu, yeye na kambi yake yote, akaja, akasimama mbele yake, akasema, "Tazama, sasa najua kwamba hakuna Mungu katika dunia yote isipokuwa katika Israeli. Basi sasa, tafadhali pokea baraka kutoka kwa mtumishi wako."
sw.B: Kisha akarudi kwa mtu wa Mungu pamoja na msafara wake wote. Akaja, akasimama mbele yake, akasema, "Sasa najua kwamba katika dunia yote hakuna Mungu isipokuwa katika Israeli. Basi sasa, tafadhali pokea zawadi kutoka kwa mtumishi wako."
sw.R: Kisha Naamani akarudi kwa mtu wa Mungu pamoja na watu wake wote. Akasimama mbele ya Elisha, akasema, "Sasa najua kwamba hakuna Mungu mahali popote duniani isipokuwa katika Israeli. Tafadhali pokea zawadi kutoka kwangu."

vi.L: Ông trở lại với người của Đức Chúa Trời, ông và cả đoàn tùy tùng, đến đứng trước mặt người và nói: "Kìa, bây giờ tôi biết rằng trên khắp đất không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài Đức Chúa Trời ở Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vậy bây giờ, xin ông nhận một món quà của đầy tớ ông."
vi.B: Rồi ông cùng cả đoàn tùy tùng trở lại gặp người của Đức Chúa Trời. Ông đến đứng trước mặt Ê-li-sê và nói: "Bây giờ tôi biết rằng trên khắp đất không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài Đức Chúa Trời ở Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vậy bây giờ, xin ông nhận một món quà của đầy tớ ông."
vi.R: Rồi Na-a-man cùng tất cả những người đi với ông trở lại gặp người của Đức Chúa Trời. Ông đứng trước mặt Ê-li-sê và nói: "Bây giờ tôi biết rằng khắp thế giới không đâu có Đức Chúa Trời, chỉ trong Y-sơ-ra-ên mới có. Xin ông nhận một món quà của tôi."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 온 진영과 함께 하나님의 사람에게 돌아와서 그 앞에 서서 말했다. "보십시오, 이제 저는 이스라엘 말고는 온 땅에 하나님이 없다는 것을 압니다. 그러니 이제 어른의 종에게서 선물을 받아 주십시오."
ko.B: 나아만은 자기 일행을 모두 거느리고 하나님의 사람에게 돌아가서 그 앞에 서서 말했다. "이제 저는 온 세상에 이스라엘 말고는 하나님이 계시지 않다는 것을 알았습니다. 그러니 이제 이 종이 드리는 선물을 받아 주십시오."
ko.R: 나아만은 데리고 온 사람들을 모두 거느리고 하나님의 사람에게 돌아갔다. 그는 엘리사 앞에 서서 말했다. "이제 저는 온 세상 어디에도 이스라엘 말고는 하나님이 안 계시다는 것을 알았습니다. 제가 드리는 선물을 부디 받아 주십시오."

decisions.choice: no God in all the earth except in Israel: Yahweh, the God of Israel, is the only true God
decisions.reason: Naaman confesses what Elisha said he would learn (verse 8). The king of Israel had said "Am I God?" (verse 7); the foreign commander now knows who God is. The same confession is heard in Deuteronomy 4:35, 39 and 1 Kings 18:39.

decisions.choice: a blessing: a gift
decisions.reason: A gift given in thanks or good will can be called a "blessing" (Genesis 33:11; 1 Samuel 25:27). Naaman offers the wealth he brought (verse 5).

decisions.choice: your servant: a polite way of saying "me"
decisions.reason: The commander now speaks of himself as the prophet's servant, a courtesy that also shows his new humility (compare verse 9).

decisions.choice: his camp: his whole traveling company
decisions.reason: The word for a camp is used here of all the men, horses and chariots traveling with Naaman.

decisions.choice: me (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "me" for the polite "your servant", as it does elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: un presente
decisions.reason: A "blessing" here is a gift (m2); Literal says "presente", a gift offered in thanks, since "bendición" alone would not be read as a gift in Spanish; Balanced and Readable say "regalo".

decisions.choice: Naaman calls Elisha "ông" and himself "tôi", "đầy tớ ông" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The proud commander, who said "ta" in his anger (verse 11), now speaks humbly to the prophet (m3).

decisions.choice: "không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài Đức Chúa Trời ở Y-sơ-ra-ên"
alternatives: "không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài Y-sơ-ra-ên"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese repeats "Đức Chúa Trời" so the sentence does not say Israel itself is God (m1).

decisions.choice: Healed, Naaman now speaks to Elisha in 합쇼체, calling himself "어른의 종" (L), "이 종" (B), "저" (R)
alternatives: 하오체, as a commander to a prophet
decisions.reason: Naaman comes back humbled (m3); as the Samuel note's "your servant" (이 종, 저 at R).

decisions.choice: "선물" for "a blessing" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "blessing" as a gift; "축복" would be heard as a spoken blessing in Korean.

source.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־עָמַ֥דְתִּי לְפָנָ֖יו אִם־אֶקָּ֑ח וַיִּפְצַר־בּ֥וֹ לָקַ֖חַת וַיְמָאֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, [As] lives Yahweh, whom I stand before him, if I will take. And he urged him to take, and he refused.

en.L: And he said, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, before whom I stand, I will not take [anything]." And he urged him to take [it], but he refused.
en.B: But Elisha said, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, whom I serve, I will accept nothing." Naaman pressed him to take it, but he refused.
en.R: But Elisha said, "I serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. As surely as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives, I will not take anything." Naaman kept urging him to take the gift, but Elisha refused.

es.L: Y él dijo: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en cuya presencia estoy, que no [lo] tomaré». Y le insistió en que [lo] tomara, pero él rehusó.
es.B: Pero Eliseo respondió: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, a quien sirvo, no aceptaré nada». Naamán le insistió para que lo tomara, pero él se negó.
es.R: Pero Eliseo dijo: «Yo sirvo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Tan cierto como que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive, no aceptaré nada». Naamán siguió insistiendo para que aceptara el regalo, pero Eliseo se negó.

fr.L: Et il dit : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, devant qui je me tiens, je ne prendrai [rien]. » Et il le pressa de prendre, mais il refusa.
fr.B: Mais Élisée dit : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, lui que je sers, je n’accepterai rien. » Naaman insista pour qu’il accepte, mais il refusa.
fr.R: Mais Élisée a dit : « Je sers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Aussi vrai qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vivant, je n’accepterai rien. » Naaman a insisté pour qu’il prenne le cadeau, mais Élisée a refusé.

sw.L: Akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, ambaye nimesimama mbele zake, sitapokea [kitu]." Akamsihi apokee, lakini akakataa.
sw.B: Lakini Elisha akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, ninayemtumikia, sitapokea kitu." Naamani akamsisitiza apokee, lakini akakataa.
sw.R: Lakini Elisha akasema, "Ninamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aishivyo, sitapokea kitu chochote." Naamani akaendelea kumsihi apokee zawadi, lakini Elisha akakataa.

vi.L: Ê-li-sê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng tôi đứng chầu trước mặt, tôi sẽ không nhận gì cả." Na-a-man nài ép ông nhận, nhưng ông từ chối.
vi.B: Nhưng Ê-li-sê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, Đấng tôi phụng sự, tôi sẽ không nhận gì cả." Na-a-man nài ép ông nhận, nhưng ông từ chối.
vi.R: Nhưng Ê-li-sê nói: "Tôi phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hằng sống, tôi sẽ không nhận gì cả." Na-a-man cứ nài ép ông nhận món quà, nhưng Ê-li-sê từ chối.

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "내가 그 앞에 서 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 [두고 맹세하는데], 내가 받지 않겠소." 그리고 그가 받으라고 그에게 강권했으나, 그가 거절했다.
ko.B: 그러나 엘리사는 말했다. "내가 섬기는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 나는 아무것도 받지 않겠소." 나아만이 받으라고 간곡히 권했으나, 엘리사는 거절했다.
ko.R: 그러나 엘리사가 말했다. "나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 사람이오. 그분께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하오. 나는 아무것도 받지 않겠소." 나아만은 선물을 받으라고 계속 권했지만 엘리사는 거절했다.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives, before whom I stand: a solemn oath, and a claim to serve Yahweh
decisions.reason: Swearing by the life of Yahweh is the strongest oath. To "stand before" someone is to serve him, as Elijah used the same words (1 Kings 17:1; 18:15; 2 Kings 3:14).

decisions.choice: if I take: in an oath, "I will not take"
