decisions.reason: In an oath, "if I do this" leaves a curse unspoken, so it means "I will not do it".

decisions.choice: Elisha refuses any gift
decisions.reason: The healing is Yahweh's free gift, not a service bought from a prophet. Elisha's refusal also keeps Naaman from thinking that he has paid for it. Gehazi's greed (verses 20-27) stands against this.

decisions.choice: whom I serve (Balanced); I serve the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "before whom I stand" means, as in 1 Kings 17:1 and 18:15. Literal keeps the picture.

source.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ נַעֲמָן֒ וָלֹ֕א יֻתַּן־נָ֣א לְעַבְדְּךָ֔ מַשָּׂ֥א צֶֽמֶד־פְּרָדִ֖ים אֲדָמָ֑ה כִּ֡י לֽוֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה֩ ע֨וֹד עַבְדְּךָ֜ עֹלָ֤ה וָזֶ֨בַח֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים כִּ֖י אִם־לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Naaman, And if not, let be given, please, to your servant [a] load of [a] pair of mules [of] earth; for not will offer again your servant burnt offering and sacrifice to gods other, except to Yahweh.

en.L: And Naaman said, "If not, then please let there be given to your servant a load of earth [for] a pair of mules, for your servant will no longer offer burnt offering or sacrifice to other gods, but only to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then Naaman said, "If not, then please let your servant be given a load of earth, as much as a pair of mules can carry, because your servant will never again offer burnt offering or sacrifice to other gods, but only to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then Naaman said, "If you will not take a gift, then please let me take home as much soil as two mules can carry. From now on I will not offer burnt offerings or sacrifices to any other gods. I will offer them only to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y dijo Naamán: «Si no, que se dé, te ruego, a tu siervo una carga de tierra [de] un par de mulas, porque tu siervo ya no ofrecerá holocausto ni sacrificio a otros dioses, sino {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Entonces Naamán dijo: «Si no, permite que a tu siervo le den una carga de tierra, la que puedan llevar dos mulas, porque tu siervo nunca más ofrecerá holocaustos ni sacrificios a otros dioses, sino solo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces Naamán dijo: «Si no aceptas un regalo, por favor, deja que me lleve a casa tanta tierra como puedan cargar dos mulas. De ahora en adelante no ofreceré holocaustos ni sacrificios a ningún otro dios. Se los ofreceré solo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Naaman dit : « Sinon, qu’on donne donc à ton serviteur la charge d’une paire de mulets [en] terre, car ton serviteur n’offrira plus d’holocauste ni de sacrifice à d’autres dieux, sinon {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Naaman dit alors : « Sinon, permets qu’on donne à ton serviteur de la terre, autant que deux mulets peuvent en porter, car ton serviteur n’offrira plus jamais d’holocauste ni de sacrifice à d’autres dieux, mais seulement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Naaman a dit alors : « Si tu ne veux pas de cadeau, permets-moi d’emporter chez moi autant de terre que deux mulets peuvent en porter. Désormais, je n’offrirai plus d’holocaustes ni de sacrifices à d’autres dieux. Je les offrirai seulement {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naamani akasema, "Kama sivyo, basi tafadhali mtumishi wako apewe udongo, mzigo wa nyumbu wawili, kwa maana mtumishi wako hatatoa tena sadaka ya kuteketezwa wala dhabihu kwa miungu mingine, ila kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tu.
sw.B: Kisha Naamani akasema, "Kama sivyo, basi tafadhali mtumishi wako apewe udongo, kiasi ambacho nyumbu wawili wanaweza kubeba, kwa sababu mtumishi wako hatatoa tena kamwe sadaka ya kuteketezwa wala dhabihu kwa miungu mingine, ila kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tu.
sw.R: Kisha Naamani akasema, "Kama hutapokea zawadi, basi tafadhali niruhusu nichukue nyumbani udongo kiasi ambacho nyumbu wawili wanaweza kubeba. Tangu sasa sitatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa wala dhabihu kwa miungu mingine yoyote. Nitazitoa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} peke yake.

vi.L: Na-a-man nói: "Nếu không, xin cho đầy tớ ông được một số đất, bằng sức chở của một cặp la, vì đầy tớ ông sẽ không còn dâng của lễ thiêu hay sinh tế cho các thần khác, mà chỉ dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thôi.
vi.B: Na-a-man nói: "Nếu ông không nhận, xin cho đầy tớ ông được đem về một số đất, đủ cho hai con la chở, vì từ nay đầy tớ ông sẽ không bao giờ dâng của lễ thiêu hay sinh tế cho các thần khác nữa, mà chỉ dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thôi.
vi.R: Na-a-man nói: "Nếu ông không nhận quà, thì xin cho tôi đem về nhà một số đất, đủ cho hai con la chở. Từ nay trở đi, tôi sẽ không dâng của lễ thiêu hay sinh tế cho thần nào khác. Tôi chỉ dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thôi.

ko.L: 그리고 나아만이 말했다. "그렇지 않으시다면, 노새 두 마리에 실을 흙을 어른의 종에게 주십시오. 어른의 종이 다시는 다른 신들에게 번제나 희생 제물을 드리지 않고, 오직 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께만 [드리겠습니다].
ko.B: 그러자 나아만이 말했다. "그러시다면, 노새 두 마리에 실을 만큼의 흙을 이 종에게 주십시오. 이 종은 이제 다른 신들에게는 번제물이나 희생 제물을 바치지 않고, 오직 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께만 바치겠습니다.
ko.R: 그러자 나아만이 말했다. "선물을 받지 않으시겠다면, 노새 두 마리에 실을 수 있을 만큼 흙을 제가 가져가게 해 주십시오. 이제부터 저는 다른 어떤 신에게도 번제물이나 희생 제물을 바치지 않겠습니다. 오직 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께만 바치겠습니다.

decisions.choice: and if not: if you will not take a gift
decisions.reason: Naaman asks for something else since Elisha will not accept his gift. The words could also mean "if not, then at least"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: a load of earth from Israel: soil from Yahweh's land, to worship Yahweh on in Aram
decisions.reason: People in that world often thought of a god as bound to his own land; David speaks of being driven out to serve other gods when he is driven from Yahweh's land (1 Samuel 26:19). Naaman wants to worship Yahweh at home on soil taken from Yahweh's land. He most likely means to build an altar of earth (Exodus 20:24), but the text does not say so.

decisions.choice: no more offerings to other gods, but only to Yahweh
decisions.reason: Naaman turns from the gods of Aram to Yahweh alone. He uses the words for the burnt offering and the sacrifice as Israel's own law does (Exodus 20:24).

decisions.choice: your servant: a polite way of saying "I"
decisions.reason: As in verse 15.

decisions.choice: me, I (Readable); take home; If you will not take a gift
decisions.reason: Readable says "me" and "I" for the polite "your servant", and spells out what "if not" refers to and where the earth is going.

decisions.choice: tu siervo (Literal, Balanced); yo, me (Readable)
decisions.reason: The polite self-reference is "tu siervo" at Literal and Balanced and the plain first person at Readable, as in the Spanish of Samuel.

decisions.choice: "번제" / "번제물" for the burnt offering and "희생 제물" for the sacrifice
decisions.reason: The Samuel drafts' words for the two kinds of offering.

source.text: לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה יִסְלַ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ בְּב֣וֹא אֲדֹנִ֣י בֵית־רִמּוֹן֩ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֨ת שָׁ֜מָּה וְה֣וּא׀נִשְׁעָ֣ן עַל־יָדִ֗י וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֵ֨יתִי֙ בֵּ֣ית רִמֹּ֔ן בְּהִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָ֨תִי֙ בֵּ֣ית רִמֹּ֔ן יִסְלַח־יְהוָ֥ה לְעַבְדְּךָ֖ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In the matter this may pardon Yahweh your servant: when goes my master [into the] house of Rimmon to bow down there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow down [in the] house of Rimmon, when I bow down [in the] house of Rimmon, may pardon Yahweh your servant in the matter this.

en.L: In this matter may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to bow down there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow down [in] the house of Rimmon, when I bow down [in] the house of Rimmon, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pardon your servant in this matter."
en.B: But in one matter may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pardon your servant: when my master goes into the temple of Rimmon to bow down there, he leans on my arm, and I too bow down in the temple of Rimmon. When I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pardon your servant in this matter."
en.R: But there is one thing I ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to forgive me for. When my master the king goes into the temple of Rimmon to worship, he leans on my arm, so I must bow down there too. When I bow in Rimmon's temple, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} forgive me for this."

es.L: En esto perdone {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a tu siervo: cuando mi señor entre en la casa de Rimón para postrarse allí, y él se apoye en mi mano, y yo me postre [en] la casa de Rimón; cuando yo me postre [en] la casa de Rimón, perdone {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a tu siervo en esto».
es.B: Pero en una cosa perdone {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a tu siervo: cuando mi señor entra en el templo de Rimón para postrarse allí, se apoya en mi brazo, y yo también me postro en el templo de Rimón. Cuando yo me postre en el templo de Rimón, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} perdone a tu siervo por esto».
es.R: Pero hay una cosa que le pido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} que me perdone. Cuando mi señor el rey entra en el templo de Rimón para adorar, se apoya en mi brazo, y yo también tengo que inclinarme allí. Cuando yo me incline en el templo de Rimón, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me perdone por esto».

fr.L: Pour cette chose, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pardonne à ton serviteur : quand mon maître entre dans la maison de Rimmôn pour s’y prosterner, et qu’il s’appuie sur ma main, et que je me prosterne [dans] la maison de Rimmôn, quand je me prosternerai [dans] la maison de Rimmôn, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pardonne à ton serviteur pour cette chose. »
fr.B: Mais sur un point, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pardonne à ton serviteur : quand mon maître entre dans le temple de Rimmôn pour s’y prosterner, il s’appuie sur mon bras, et je me prosterne moi aussi dans le temple de Rimmôn. Quand je me prosternerai dans le temple de Rimmôn, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pardonne à ton serviteur sur ce point. »
fr.R: Mais il y a une chose pour laquelle je demande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de me pardonner. Quand le roi, mon maître, entre dans le temple de Rimmôn pour adorer, il s’appuie sur mon bras, et je dois m’incliner là aussi. Quand je m’inclinerai dans le temple de Rimmôn, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me pardonne cela. »

sw.L: Katika jambo hili {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amsamehe mtumishi wako: bwana wangu aingiapo katika nyumba ya Rimoni ili kusujudu huko, naye anaegemea mkono wangu, nami nasujudu [katika] nyumba ya Rimoni, nisujudupo [katika] nyumba ya Rimoni, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amsamehe mtumishi wako katika jambo hili."
sw.B: Lakini katika jambo moja {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amsamehe mtumishi wako: bwana wangu anapoingia katika hekalu la Rimoni kusujudu huko, huegemea mkono wangu, nami pia hulazimika kusujudu katika hekalu la Rimoni. Ninaposujudu katika hekalu la Rimoni, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amsamehe mtumishi wako katika jambo hili."
sw.R: Lakini kuna jambo moja ninalomwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anisamehe. Bwana wangu mfalme anapoingia katika hekalu la Rimoni kuabudu, huegemea mkono wangu, kwa hiyo mimi pia lazima nisujudu humo. Ninaposujudu katika hekalu la Rimoni, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anisamehe kwa jambo hili."

vi.L: Trong việc này, xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tha thứ cho đầy tớ ông: khi chủ tôi vào nhà Rim-môn để thờ lạy ở đó, và vua tựa trên tay tôi, và tôi cúi lạy [trong] nhà Rim-môn, khi tôi cúi lạy [trong] nhà Rim-môn, xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tha thứ cho đầy tớ ông trong việc này."
vi.B: Chỉ có một việc xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tha thứ cho đầy tớ ông: khi chủ tôi vào đền thờ Rim-môn để thờ lạy, vua tựa vào cánh tay tôi, và tôi cũng cúi lạy trong đền thờ Rim-môn. Khi tôi cúi lạy trong đền thờ Rim-môn, xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tha thứ cho đầy tớ ông trong việc này."
vi.R: Nhưng có một việc tôi xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tha thứ cho tôi. Khi vua là chủ tôi vào đền thờ Rim-môn để thờ lạy, vua tựa vào cánh tay tôi, nên tôi cũng phải cúi lạy ở đó. Khi tôi cúi lạy trong đền thờ Rim-môn, xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tha thứ cho tôi về việc này."

ko.L: 이 일에 대해서는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어른의 종을 용서해 주시기 바랍니다. 내 주인이 림몬의 집에 들어가 거기서 절할 때에 그가 내 손에 기대고, 내가 림몬의 집에서 절하게 되면, 내가 림몬의 집에서 절할 때에, 이 일에 대해서는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어른의 종을 용서해 주시기 바랍니다."
ko.B: 그러나 한 가지 일만은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 종을 용서해 주시기 바랍니다. 제 주인께서 림몬 신전에 들어가 거기서 절할 때에 제 팔에 기대시므로, 저도 림몬 신전에서 몸을 굽혀야 합니다. 제가 림몬 신전에서 몸을 굽힐 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 일로 이 종을 용서해 주시기 바랍니다."
ko.R: 그러나 한 가지만은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 저를 용서해 주시기를 바랍니다. 제 주인이신 왕께서 림몬 신전에 들어가 예배할 때에 제 팔에 기대십니다. 그래서 저도 그곳에서 절을 해야 합니다. 제가 림몬 신전에서 절할 때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 저를 용서해 주시기를 바랍니다."

decisions.choice: Rimmon: the chief god of Damascus
decisions.reason: Rimmon was the god worshiped in Damascus, probably the storm god Hadad under a title meaning "Thunderer". The name is found in the names of Aramean kings, such as Tabrimmon (1 Kings 15:18).

decisions.choice: Naaman asks in advance for pardon for bowing in Rimmon's temple when he must attend his king
alternatives: Naaman asks pardon for what he has done in the past
decisions.reason: Naaman has just vowed to worship Yahweh alone (verse 17). As the king's chief officer he will still have to go with him into Rimmon's temple and bow when the king bows. He does not call this worship of Rimmon; he names it as a thing needing pardon and asks Yahweh to forgive it. Elisha's answer, "Go in peace" (verse 19), does not discuss the request, and whether it grants it is not said.

decisions.choice: he leans on my hand: the king leans on Naaman's arm
decisions.reason: To lean on an officer's arm was the place of the king's closest attendant (7:2, 17). When the king bows, the officer bows with him.

decisions.choice: bow down: the act of worship, bowing to the ground
decisions.reason: The verb means to bow low, and it is the usual word for worship (Exodus 20:5). It is said three times here of Naaman and the king.

decisions.choice: your servant: a polite way of saying "me"
decisions.reason: As in verse 15.

decisions.choice: temple (Balanced, Readable) for "house"; arm for "hand"; my master the king; so I must
decisions.reason: The "house" of a god is his temple, and Balanced and Readable say so. Readable names the master as the king, says "me" for "your servant", and says what the Hebrew implies: Naaman's duty means he must bow with the king.

decisions.choice: "Rim-môn"
decisions.reason: The god of Damascus in the usual Vietnamese form; Literal keeps "nhà" for "house", Balanced and Readable say "đền thờ".

decisions.choice: "림몬 신전" at Balanced and Readable for "the house of Rimmon"; Literal keeps "림몬의 집"
decisions.reason: "성전" is kept for the LORD's temple in these drafts; a foreign god's house is "신전".

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ לֵ֣ךְ לְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מֵאִתּ֖וֹ כִּבְרַת־אָֽרֶץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he said to him, Go in peace. And he went from him a stretch of land.

en.L: And he said to him, "Go in peace." And he went from him a stretch of land.
en.B: Elisha said to him, "Go in peace." So Naaman left him and went some distance.
en.R: Elisha told him, "Go in peace." So Naaman left, and he traveled a short way.

es.L: Y él le dijo: «Ve en paz». Y se alejó de él un trecho de tierra.
es.B: Eliseo le dijo: «Ve en paz». Y Naamán se fue y recorrió cierta distancia.
es.R: Eliseo le dijo: «Ve en paz». Así que Naamán se fue y avanzó un corto trecho.

fr.L: Et il lui dit : « Va en paix. » Et il s’éloigna de lui d’une certaine distance de terrain.
fr.B: Élisée lui dit : « Va en paix. » Naaman le quitta donc et fit un bout de chemin.
fr.R: Élisée lui a dit : « Va en paix. » Alors Naaman est parti, et il avait fait un petit bout de chemin.

sw.L: Akamwambia, "Nenda kwa amani." Akaondoka kwake, akaenda umbali wa nchi.
sw.B: Elisha akamwambia, "Nenda kwa amani." Basi Naamani akaondoka kwake, akaenda umbali fulani.
sw.R: Elisha akamwambia, "Nenda kwa amani." Basi Naamani akaondoka, akasafiri umbali mfupi.

vi.L: Ê-li-sê nói với ông: "Hãy đi bình an." Ông rời khỏi Ê-li-sê và đi được một quãng đường.
vi.B: Ê-li-sê nói với ông: "Ông hãy đi bình an." Vậy Na-a-man từ giã Ê-li-sê và đi được một quãng.
vi.R: Ê-li-sê bảo ông: "Ông hãy đi bình an." Vậy Na-a-man ra đi, và ông đi được một quãng ngắn.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그에게 말했다. "평안히 가시오." 그래서 그가 그에게서 떠나 얼마쯤 갔다.
ko.B: 엘리사가 그에게 말했다. "평안히 가시오." 나아만은 그를 떠나 얼마쯤 갔다.
ko.R: 엘리사가 그에게 말했다. "평안히 가시오." 나아만은 엘리사를 떠나 조금 갔다.

decisions.choice: go in peace: a farewell blessing
decisions.reason: The words send a person away with good will and wish him well (1 Samuel 1:17; 20:42). Elisha does not answer Naaman's request in so many words; the farewell leaves it with Yahweh.

decisions.choice: a stretch of land: some distance, length unknown
decisions.reason: The phrase is used for the distance still to go in Genesis 35:16 and 48:7. Its exact length is not known; here it was short enough for Gehazi to catch up on foot (verse 21).

decisions.choice: a short way
decisions.reason: Readable says "short" because Gehazi soon overtakes Naaman on foot.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּיחֲזִ֗י נַעַר֮ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים֒ הִנֵּ֣ה׀חָשַׂ֣ךְ אֲדֹנִ֗י אֶֽת־נַעֲמָ֤ן הָֽאֲרַמִּי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה מִקַּ֥חַת מִיָּד֖וֹ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִ֑יא חַי־יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־אִם־רַ֣צְתִּי אַחֲרָ֔יו וְלָקַחְתִּ֥י מֵאִתּ֖וֹ מְאֽוּמָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Gehazi, [the] young man of Elisha, [the] man of the God, Behold, has spared my master Naaman the Aramean this from taking from his hand what he brought. [As] lives Yahweh, surely I will run after him and take from him something.

en.L: And Gehazi, the young man of Elisha the man of God, said, "Look, my master has spared Naaman this Aramean, not taking from his hand what he brought. [As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, I will surely run after him and take something from him."
en.B: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said to himself, "My master has let this Aramean Naaman off without taking any of the things he brought. As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, I will chase after him and take something from him."
en.R: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, thought, "My master let Naaman, this man from Aram, off too easily. He did not take any of the gifts Naaman brought. As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, I will chase after him and take something from him."

es.L: Y dijo Giezi, criado de Eliseo el hombre de Dios: «He aquí, mi señor ha eximido a este arameo Naamán, no tomando de su mano lo que trajo. Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que correré tras él y tomaré algo de él».
es.B: Giezi, el criado de Eliseo el hombre de Dios, se dijo: «Mi señor ha dejado ir a este arameo Naamán sin aceptarle nada de lo que trajo. Tan cierto como que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive, correré tras él y le sacaré algo».
es.R: Giezi, el criado de Eliseo el hombre de Dios, pensó: «Mi amo dejó ir con demasiada facilidad a Naamán, ese hombre de Aram. No aceptó nada de los regalos que Naamán trajo. Tan cierto como que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive, voy a correr tras él y sacarle algo».

fr.L: Et Guéhazi, le jeune homme d’Élisée, l’homme de Dieu, dit : « Voici, mon maître a ménagé ce Naaman, l’Araméen, en ne prenant pas de sa main ce qu’il avait apporté. [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, je vais courir après lui et prendre de lui quelque chose. »
fr.B: Guéhazi, le serviteur d’Élisée, l’homme de Dieu, se dit : « Mon maître a laissé partir cet Araméen, Naaman, sans rien accepter de ce qu’il avait apporté. Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, je vais courir après lui et en obtenir quelque chose. »
fr.R: Guéhazi, le serviteur d’Élisée, l’homme de Dieu, a pensé : « Mon maître a été trop gentil avec Naaman, cet homme d’Aram. Il n’a rien pris des cadeaux que Naaman avait apportés. Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, je vais courir après lui et obtenir quelque chose. »

sw.L: Gehazi, kijana wa Elisha mtu wa Mungu, akasema, "Tazama, bwana wangu amemwachilia Naamani huyu Mwaramu, kwa kutopokea mkononi mwake vile alivyoleta. Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, hakika nitapiga mbio nimfuate, nichukue kitu kutoka kwake."
sw.B: Gehazi, mtumishi wa Elisha mtu wa Mungu, akasema moyoni mwake, "Bwana wangu amemwachilia huyu Mwaramu Naamani bila kupokea chochote katika vitu alivyoleta. Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, nitamkimbilia nichukue kitu kutoka kwake."
sw.R: Gehazi, mtumishi wa Elisha mtu wa Mungu, akawaza, "Bwana wangu amemwachilia Naamani, mtu huyu wa Aramu, kwa urahisi mno. Hakupokea zawadi yoyote kati ya zile alizoleta Naamani. Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, nitamkimbilia nichukue kitu kutoka kwake."

vi.L: Ghê-ha-xi, người đầy tớ trẻ của Ê-li-sê, người của Đức Chúa Trời, nói: "Kìa, chủ ta đã tha cho tên A-ram Na-a-man này, không nhận từ tay hắn những gì hắn đem đến. Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, ta sẽ chạy theo hắn và lấy của hắn một ít."
vi.B: Ghê-ha-xi, đầy tớ của Ê-li-sê, người của Đức Chúa Trời, tự nhủ: "Thầy ta đã để cho tên A-ram Na-a-man này đi mà không nhận chút gì trong những thứ hắn đem đến. Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, ta sẽ chạy theo hắn và lấy của hắn một ít."
vi.R: Ghê-ha-xi, đầy tớ của Ê-li-sê, người của Đức Chúa Trời, nghĩ thầm: "Thầy ta đã để cho Na-a-man, người A-ram này, đi quá dễ dàng. Thầy chẳng nhận món quà nào hắn đem đến. Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, ta sẽ đuổi theo hắn và lấy của hắn một ít."

ko.L: 그리고 하나님의 사람 엘리사의 젊은 종 게하시가 말했다. "보라, 내 주인이 이 아람 사람 나아만에게서 그가 가져온 것을 그의 손에서 받지 않고 그를 그냥 보냈다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 [두고 맹세하는데], 내가 반드시 그를 뒤쫓아 가서 그에게서 무엇이든 받아 내겠다."
ko.B: 하나님의 사람 엘리사의 종 게하시가 속으로 말했다. "내 주인은 이 아람 사람 나아만이 가져온 것을 하나도 받지 않고 그냥 보내 주었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 내가 그를 뒤쫓아 가서 무엇이든 받아 내야겠다."
ko.R: 하나님의 사람 엘리사의 종 게하시는 생각했다. '내 주인은 아람 사람 나아만을 너무 쉽게 보내 주었다. 나아만이 가져온 선물을 하나도 받지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 내가 그를 뒤쫓아 가서 무엇이든 받아 내야겠다.'

decisions.choice: young man: servant, personal attendant
decisions.reason: The word means a young man, and often a servant or attendant (1 Kings 18:43). Gehazi has served Elisha in the story of the Shunammite woman (4:12, 25).

decisions.choice: said: said to himself
decisions.reason: No one is with Gehazi; "said" here means that he thought or decided.

decisions.choice: spared this Aramean: let him go without paying
decisions.reason: The verb means to hold back or spare. Gehazi thinks his master was too easy on a foreigner, and "this Aramean" carries his contempt for Naaman.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives: Gehazi swears the oath his master swore
decisions.reason: Elisha swore by Yahweh's life that he would take nothing (verse 16); Gehazi swears by the same name that he will take something. The writer sets the two oaths side by side.

decisions.choice: the servant (Balanced, Readable); said to himself (Balanced), thought (Readable); off too easily (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "servant" for "young man" and show that the words are Gehazi's thoughts. Readable says what "spared" means here and splits the sentence.

decisions.choice: Gehazi speaks of Naaman as "tên A-ram ... hắn"
decisions.reason: His contempt for the foreigner shows in the pronouns he uses to himself (m3); to Naaman's face he says "ông" (verse 22).

source.text: וַיִּרְדֹּ֥ף גֵּיחֲזִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י נַֽעֲמָ֑ן וַיִּרְאֶ֤ה נַֽעֲמָן֙ רָ֣ץ אַחֲרָ֔יו וַיִּפֹּ֞ל מֵעַ֧ל הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לִקְרָאת֖וֹ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הֲשָׁלֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And pursued Gehazi after Naaman, and saw Naaman [one] running after him, and he fell from on the chariot to meet him and said, [Is it] peace?

en.L: And Gehazi pursued after Naaman. And Naaman saw [one] running after him, and he got down from the chariot to meet him and said, "[Is it] peace?"
en.B: So Gehazi hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw someone running after him, he got down from his chariot to meet him and asked, "Is everything all right?"
en.R: So Gehazi chased after Naaman. When Naaman saw a man running after him, he quickly got down from his chariot to meet him. He asked, "Is everything all right?"

es.L: Y Giezi siguió tras Naamán. Y Naamán vio [a alguien] corriendo tras él, y bajó del carro a su encuentro y dijo: «¿[Hay] paz?».
es.B: Así que Giezi se fue tras Naamán. Cuando Naamán vio que alguien corría tras él, se bajó del carro para recibirlo y le preguntó: «¿Todo está bien?».
es.R: Así que Giezi corrió tras Naamán. Cuando Naamán vio a un hombre que corría tras él, se bajó enseguida de su carro para recibirlo. Le preguntó: «¿Todo está bien?».

fr.L: Et Guéhazi poursuivit Naaman. Et Naaman vit [quelqu’un] courir derrière lui, et il descendit du char à sa rencontre et dit : « [Est-ce] la paix ? »
fr.B: Guéhazi se lança donc à la poursuite de Naaman. Quand Naaman vit quelqu’un courir derrière lui, il descendit de son char pour aller à sa rencontre et demanda : « Tout va bien ? »
fr.R: Guéhazi a donc couru après Naaman. Quand Naaman a vu un homme courir derrière lui, il est vite descendu de son char pour aller à sa rencontre. Il lui a demandé : « Tout va bien ? »

sw.L: Gehazi akamfuatia Naamani. Naamani akaona [mtu] anapiga mbio kumfuata, akashuka kutoka garini kumlaki, akasema, "[Je, ni] salama?"
sw.B: Basi Gehazi akamfuata Naamani mbio. Naamani alipoona mtu anapiga mbio kumfuata, alishuka kutoka garini mwake kumlaki, akamwuliza, "Je, ni salama?"
sw.R: Basi Gehazi akamkimbilia Naamani. Naamani alipomwona mtu anakimbia nyuma yake, alishuka upesi kutoka garini mwake kumlaki. Akamwuliza, "Je, kila kitu ni salama?"

vi.L: Ghê-ha-xi đuổi theo Na-a-man. Na-a-man thấy có người chạy theo mình, liền xuống khỏi xe để đón và nói: "Bình an chứ?"
vi.B: Vậy Ghê-ha-xi vội đuổi theo Na-a-man. Khi thấy có người chạy theo mình, Na-a-man xuống xe đón và hỏi: "Mọi việc vẫn ổn chứ?"
vi.R: Vậy Ghê-ha-xi đuổi theo Na-a-man. Khi Na-a-man thấy có người chạy theo mình, ông vội xuống xe để đón. Ông hỏi: "Mọi việc vẫn ổn chứ?"

ko.L: 그리고 게하시가 나아만을 뒤쫓아 갔다. 그리고 나아만이 [어떤 사람이] 자기 뒤를 쫓아 달려오는 것을 보고, 병거에서 내려 그를 맞으며 말했다. "평안한 일이오?"
ko.B: 그래서 게하시는 나아만을 급히 뒤쫓아 갔다. 나아만은 누군가 자기 뒤를 쫓아 달려오는 것을 보고, 병거에서 내려 그를 맞으며 물었다. "무슨 일이 있소?"
ko.R: 그래서 게하시는 나아만을 뒤쫓아 갔다. 나아만은 어떤 사람이 자기 뒤를 쫓아 달려오는 것을 보고, 얼른 병거에서 내려 그를 맞이했다. 나아만이 물었다. "무슨 일이 있소?"

decisions.choice: fell from the chariot: got down quickly
decisions.reason: The verb "fall" is used of getting down from a mount or chariot at once, as Rebekah does from her camel (Genesis 24:64). Naaman honors the prophet's servant by stepping down to meet him.

decisions.choice: is it peace?: is all well?
decisions.reason: The question asks whether all is well and whether the one coming brings good news (4:26; 9:17-22). Naaman wonders why the prophet's servant is running after him.

decisions.choice: got down (Literal)
decisions.reason: Literal says "got down" for "fell", since "fell from the chariot" would suggest an accident in English; meaning decision m1 gives the Hebrew picture.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀שָׁל֗וֹם אֲדֹנִי֮ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי לֵאמֹר֒ הִנֵּ֣ה עַתָּ֡ה זֶ֠ה בָּ֣אוּ אֵלַ֧י שְׁנֵֽי־נְעָרִ֛ים מֵהַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֖יִם מִבְּנֵ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים תְּנָה־נָּ֤א לָהֶם֙ כִּכַּר־כֶּ֔סֶף וּשְׁתֵּ֖י חֲלִפ֥וֹת בְּגָדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Peace. My master has sent me, saying, Behold, now just this have come to me two young men from [the] hill country of Ephraim, from [the] sons of the prophets. Give, please, to them a talent of silver and two changes of garments.

en.L: And he said, "Peace. My master has sent me, saying, 'Look, just now two young men have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim, from the sons of the prophets. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothes.'"
en.B: He answered, "All is well. My master has sent me to say, 'Two young men of the company of prophets have just arrived from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them {{units:about 75 pounds of silver|a talent of silver}} and two sets of clothes.'"
en.R: Gehazi answered, "Everything is fine. My master sent me with this message: 'Two young men from the group of prophets have just arrived here from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them {{units:about 75 pounds of silver|a talent of silver}} and two sets of clothes.'"

es.L: Y él dijo: «Paz. Mi señor me ha enviado a decir: “He aquí que ahora mismo han venido a mí dos jóvenes de la región montañosa de Efraín, de los hijos de los profetas. Te ruego que les des un talento de plata y dos mudas de ropa”».
es.B: Él respondió: «Todo está bien. Mi señor me ha enviado a decirte: “Acaban de llegar de la región montañosa de Efraín dos jóvenes de los discípulos de los profetas. Por favor, dales {{units:unos 34 kilos de plata|un talento de plata}} y dos mudas de ropa”».
es.R: Giezi respondió: «Todo está bien. Mi amo me envió con este mensaje: “Acaban de llegar de la región montañosa de Efraín dos jóvenes del grupo de profetas. Por favor, dales {{units:unos 34 kilos de plata|un talento de plata}} y dos mudas de ropa”».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Paix. Mon maître m’envoie dire : “Voici, à l’instant même, deux jeunes gens d’entre les fils des prophètes sont arrivés chez moi de la montagne d’Éphraïm. Donne-leur, je te prie, un talent d’argent et deux vêtements de rechange.” »
fr.B: Il répondit : « Tout va bien. Mon maître m’envoie te dire : “Deux jeunes gens d’entre les disciples des prophètes viennent d’arriver chez moi de la montagne d’Éphraïm. Donne-leur, je te prie, {{units:environ 34 kg d’argent|un talent d’argent}} et deux vêtements de rechange.” »
fr.R: Guéhazi a répondu : « Tout va bien. Mon maître m’envoie avec ce message : “Deux jeunes hommes du groupe de prophètes viennent d’arriver chez moi de la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm. S’il te plaît, donne-leur {{units:environ 34 kg d’argent|un talent d’argent}} et deux vêtements de rechange.” »

sw.L: Akasema, "[Ni] salama. Bwana wangu amenituma, akisema, 'Tazama, sasa hivi vijana wawili wa wana wa manabii wamenijia kutoka nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Tafadhali wape talanta ya fedha na mavazi mawili ya kubadili.'"
sw.B: Akajibu, "Ni salama. Bwana wangu amenituma kusema, 'Vijana wawili wa kundi la manabii wamewasili sasa hivi kutoka nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Tafadhali wape {{units:karibu kilo 34 za fedha|talanta moja ya fedha}} na mavazi mawili.'"
sw.R: Gehazi akajibu, "Kila kitu ni salama. Bwana wangu amenituma na ujumbe huu: 'Vijana wawili wa kundi la manabii wamefika hapa sasa hivi kutoka nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Tafadhali wape {{units:karibu kilo 34 za fedha|talanta moja ya fedha}} na mavazi mawili.'"

vi.L: Ghê-ha-xi nói: "Bình an. Chủ tôi sai tôi đến nói: 'Kìa, vừa mới có hai thanh niên trong các con trai của các nhà tiên tri từ miền đồi núi Ép-ra-im đến với tôi. Xin ông cho họ một ta-lâng bạc và hai bộ áo.'"
vi.B: Ghê-ha-xi đáp: "Mọi việc đều ổn. Thầy tôi sai tôi đến nói: 'Vừa có hai thanh niên trong đoàn tiên tri từ miền đồi núi Ép-ra-im đến với tôi. Xin ông cho họ {{units:khoảng 34 kg bạc|một ta-lâng bạc}} và hai bộ áo.'"
vi.R: Ghê-ha-xi trả lời: "Mọi việc đều tốt. Thầy tôi sai tôi đến nói với ông: 'Vừa có hai thanh niên trong đoàn tiên tri từ miền đồi núi Ép-ra-im đến đây. Xin ông cho họ {{units:khoảng 34 kg bạc|một ta-lâng bạc}} và hai bộ áo.'"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말했다. "평안합니다. 제 주인께서 저를 보내어 말씀하셨습니다. '보시오, 방금 에브라임 산지에서 예언자의 아들들 가운데 젊은이 두 사람이 내게 왔으니, 그들에게 은 한 달란트와 옷 두 벌을 주시오.'"
ko.B: 게하시가 대답했다. "별일 없습니다. 제 주인께서 저를 보내셔서 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다. '방금 예언자 무리 가운데 젊은이 두 사람이 에브라임 산지에서 내게 왔으니, 그들에게 {{units:은 34킬로그램쯤과|은 한 달란트와}} 옷 두 벌을 주시오.'"
ko.R: 게하시가 대답했다. "아무 일도 없습니다. 제 주인께서 저를 보내셔서 이렇게 전하라고 하셨습니다. '예언자 무리에 속한 젊은이 두 사람이 에브라임 산지에서 방금 이곳에 왔소. 그들에게 {{units:은 34킬로그램쯤과|은 한 달란트와}} 옷 두 벌을 주시오.'"

decisions.choice: my master has sent me: a lie
decisions.reason: Elisha has sent no one. Gehazi invents a message in his master's name to get the gifts the prophet refused (verses 16, 25-26).

decisions.choice: sons of the prophets: members of a group of prophets
decisions.reason: "Sons of" here means members of a group. These communities of prophets lived and learned around Elijah and Elisha (2:3-7; 4:1, 38).

decisions.choice: the hill country of Ephraim; a talent of silver
decisions.reason: The hill country of Ephraim is the central highlands of Israel, where Bethel lay (2:3). A talent, about 75 pounds of silver, is far less than Naaman brought (verse 5) but still a great sum, and it sounds like a plausible request for poor prophets.

decisions.choice: about 75 pounds of silver (a talent of silver)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the modern weight with the original unit as the alternative. "Company of prophets" and "group of prophets" follow the wording used for this phrase in these books.

decisions.choice: Gehazi speaks to Naaman in 합쇼체 and puts in Elisha's mouth the 하오체 Elisha used with Naaman
alternatives: the plain style for the made-up message
decisions.reason: The lie (m1) is told in the voice Naaman has heard from Elisha.

decisions.choice: "{{units:은 34킬로그램쯤과|은 한 달란트와}}", with the particle inside the span
decisions.reason: Metric by default (talent 34 kg); the particle differs with the wording, so it goes inside the span.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נַעֲמָ֔ן הוֹאֵ֖ל קַ֣ח כִּכָּרָ֑יִם וַיִּפְרָץ־בּ֗וֹ וַיָּצַר֩ כִּכְּרַ֨יִם כֶּ֜סֶף בִּשְׁנֵ֣י חֲרִטִ֗ים וּשְׁתֵּי֙ חֲלִפ֣וֹת בְּגָדִ֔ים וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶל־שְׁנֵ֣י נְעָרָ֔יו וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Naaman, Be pleased, take two talents. And he urged him, and he tied up two talents of silver in two bags and two changes of garments and gave [them] to two of his young men, and they carried [them] before him.

en.L: And Naaman said, "Be pleased to take two talents." And he urged him, and he tied up two talents of silver in two bags, and two changes of clothes, and gave [them] to two of his young men, and they carried [them] before him.
en.B: Naaman said, "Please, take {{units:about 150 pounds|two talents}}." He pressed Gehazi to take them, and tied up {{units:about 150 pounds of silver|two talents of silver}} in two bags, with two sets of clothes. He gave them to two of his servants, and they carried them ahead of Gehazi.
en.R: Naaman said, "Please take {{units:about 150 pounds|two talents}}." He kept urging Gehazi to take them. He tied up {{units:about 150 pounds of silver|two talents of silver}} in two bags, along with two sets of clothes. Then he gave them to two of his servants, and they carried them ahead of Gehazi.

es.L: Y dijo Naamán: «Dígnate tomar dos talentos». Y le insistió, y ató dos talentos de plata en dos bolsas, y dos mudas de ropa, y [los] dio a dos de sus criados, y [los] llevaron delante de él.
es.B: Naamán le dijo: «Por favor, toma {{units:unos 68 kilos|dos talentos}}». Le insistió a Giezi que los tomara, y ató {{units:unos 68 kilos de plata|dos talentos de plata}} en dos bolsas, con dos mudas de ropa. Se los dio a dos de sus criados, y ellos los llevaron delante de Giezi.
es.R: Naamán le dijo: «Por favor, toma {{units:unos 68 kilos|dos talentos}}». Siguió insistiéndole a Giezi que los tomara. Ató {{units:unos 68 kilos de plata|dos talentos de plata}} en dos bolsas, junto con dos mudas de ropa. Luego se los dio a dos de sus criados, y ellos los llevaron delante de Giezi.

fr.L: Et Naaman dit : « Consens à prendre deux talents. » Et il le pressa, et il serra deux talents d’argent dans deux sacs, avec deux vêtements de rechange, et il les donna à deux de ses jeunes gens, qui les portèrent devant lui.
fr.B: Naaman dit : « Accepte donc {{units:environ 68 kg|deux talents}}. » Il insista auprès de Guéhazi, puis il serra {{units:environ 68 kg d’argent|deux talents d’argent}} dans deux sacs, avec deux vêtements de rechange. Il les remit à deux de ses serviteurs, qui les portèrent devant Guéhazi.
fr.R: Naaman a dit : « S’il te plaît, prends {{units:environ 68 kg|deux talents}}. » Il a insisté pour que Guéhazi les prenne. Il a attaché {{units:environ 68 kg d’argent|deux talents d’argent}} dans deux sacs, avec deux vêtements de rechange. Puis il les a donnés à deux de ses serviteurs, et ils les ont portés devant Guéhazi.

sw.L: Naamani akasema, "Uwe radhi, chukua talanta mbili." Akamsihi, akafunga talanta mbili za fedha katika mifuko miwili, pamoja na mavazi mawili ya kubadili, akawapa vijana wake wawili, nao wakavibeba mbele yake.
sw.B: Naamani akasema, "Tafadhali chukua {{units:karibu kilo 68|talanta mbili}}." Akamsisitiza Gehazi azichukue, akafunga {{units:karibu kilo 68 za fedha|talanta mbili za fedha}} katika mifuko miwili, pamoja na mavazi mawili. Akawapa watumishi wake wawili, nao wakavibeba mbele ya Gehazi.
sw.R: Naamani akasema, "Tafadhali chukua {{units:karibu kilo 68|talanta mbili}}." Akaendelea kumsihi Gehazi azichukue. Akafunga {{units:karibu kilo 68 za fedha|talanta mbili za fedha}} katika mifuko miwili, pamoja na mavazi mawili. Kisha akawapa watumishi wake wawili, nao wakavibeba mbele ya Gehazi.

vi.L: Na-a-man nói: "Xin vui lòng nhận hai ta-lâng." Ông nài ép Ghê-ha-xi, rồi buộc hai ta-lâng bạc vào hai cái túi cùng với hai bộ áo, và trao cho hai người đầy tớ trẻ của mình, và họ mang đi trước Ghê-ha-xi.
vi.B: Na-a-man nói: "Xin cứ nhận {{units:khoảng 68 kg|hai ta-lâng}}." Ông nài ép Ghê-ha-xi nhận, rồi buộc {{units:khoảng 68 kg bạc|hai ta-lâng bạc}} vào hai cái túi, cùng với hai bộ áo. Ông trao cho hai đầy tớ của mình, và họ mang đi trước Ghê-ha-xi.
vi.R: Na-a-man nói: "Xin cứ nhận {{units:khoảng 68 kg|hai ta-lâng}}." Ông cứ nài Ghê-ha-xi nhận. Ông buộc {{units:khoảng 68 kg bạc|hai ta-lâng bạc}} vào hai cái túi, cùng với hai bộ áo. Rồi ông trao cho hai đầy tớ của mình, và họ mang đi trước Ghê-ha-xi.

ko.L: 그리고 나아만이 말했다. "부디 두 달란트를 받으시오." 그리고 그가 그에게 강권하고, 은 두 달란트를 두 자루에 넣어 묶고 옷 두 벌과 함께 자기 젊은 종 두 사람에게 주니, 그들이 그 앞에서 [그것들을] 지고 갔다.
ko.B: 나아만이 말했다. "{{units:68킬로그램쯤을|두 달란트를}} 받아 주시오." 나아만은 게하시에게 받으라고 간곡히 권하며 {{units:은 68킬로그램쯤을|은 두 달란트를}} 두 자루에 넣어 묶고, 옷 두 벌과 함께 자기 종 두 사람에게 주었다. 그들은 그것을 지고 게하시 앞에서 걸어갔다.
ko.R: 나아만이 말했다. "부디 {{units:68킬로그램쯤을|두 달란트를}} 받으시오." 그는 게하시에게 받으라고 자꾸 권했다. 그리고 {{units:은 68킬로그램쯤을|은 두 달란트를}} 두 자루에 나누어 넣어 묶고, 옷 두 벌도 함께 챙겼다. 그는 그것들을 자기 종 두 사람에게 주었고, 그들은 그것을 지고 게하시 앞에서 걸어갔다.

decisions.choice: be pleased: a polite form of request
decisions.reason: The verb means to be willing or to agree; with a command it makes a courteous request (Judges 19:6).

decisions.choice: he urged him ... he tied ... before him: Naaman urges Gehazi, and the servants walk ahead of Gehazi
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses "he" and "him" throughout. Naaman, glad to give, doubles the sum and sends two of his own men to carry it, one bag each.

decisions.choice: bags: purses or sacks that could be tied shut
decisions.reason: The word is used elsewhere only for a woman's handbag or purse (Isaiah 3:22). Here they are bags large enough for a talent of silver each.

decisions.choice: his young men: his servants
decisions.reason: As in verse 20, the word means attendants.

decisions.choice: about 150 pounds (two talents)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the modern weight, with the original unit as the alternative. They name Gehazi where the Hebrew says "him".

source.text: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־הָעֹ֔פֶל וַיִּקַּ֥ח מִיָּדָ֖ם וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד בַּבָּ֑יִת וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he came to the hill, and took [them] from their hand and deposited [them] in [the] house; and he sent away the men, and they went.

en.L: And he came to the hill, and he took [them] from their hand and stored [them] in the house, and he sent the men away, and they went.
en.B: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the things from them and put them away in the house. Then he sent the men off, and they left.
en.R: When Gehazi reached the hill, he took the bags and clothes from the servants and put them away inside the house. Then he sent the men away, and they left.

es.L: Y llegó a la colina, y [los] tomó de sus manos y [los] guardó en la casa; y despidió a los hombres, y se fueron.
es.B: Cuando Giezi llegó a la colina, les tomó las cosas y las guardó en la casa. Luego despidió a los hombres, y ellos se fueron.
es.R: Cuando Giezi llegó a la colina, les quitó a los criados las bolsas y la ropa y las guardó dentro de la casa. Luego despidió a los hombres, y ellos se fueron.

fr.L: Et il arriva à la colline, et il [les] prit de leur main et [les] déposa dans la maison ; et il renvoya les hommes, et ils s’en allèrent.
fr.B: Arrivé à la colline, Guéhazi prit les objets de leurs mains et les rangea dans la maison. Puis il renvoya les hommes, et ils partirent.
fr.R: Quand Guéhazi est arrivé à la colline, il a pris les sacs et les vêtements des mains des serviteurs et il les a cachés dans la maison. Ensuite il a renvoyé les hommes, et ils sont partis.

sw.L: Akafika kilimani, akavichukua mikononi mwao, akaviweka nyumbani; akawaaga watu hao, nao wakaenda zao.
sw.B: Gehazi alipofika kilimani, alivichukua vitu hivyo kutoka kwao, akaviweka ndani ya nyumba. Kisha akawaaga watu hao, nao wakaondoka.
sw.R: Gehazi alipofika kilimani, aliichukua ile mifuko na mavazi kutoka kwa watumishi, akaviweka ndani ya nyumba. Kisha akawaaga watu hao, nao wakaondoka.

vi.L: Khi đến ngọn đồi, Ghê-ha-xi lấy [các thứ] từ tay họ và cất vào trong nhà; rồi cho những người ấy về, và họ ra đi.
vi.B: Khi đến ngọn đồi, Ghê-ha-xi lấy các thứ ấy từ tay họ và cất vào trong nhà. Rồi Ghê-ha-xi cho họ về, và họ ra đi.
vi.R: Khi đến ngọn đồi, Ghê-ha-xi lấy túi bạc và quần áo từ tay các đầy tớ, rồi đem cất vào trong nhà. Sau đó Ghê-ha-xi cho họ về, và họ ra đi.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 언덕에 이르러 그들의 손에서 [그것들을] 받아 집에 두었다. 그리고 그 사람들을 돌려보냈고, 그들이 갔다.
ko.B: 게하시는 언덕에 이르자 그 물건들을 그들에게서 받아 집 안에 감추어 두었다. 그러고는 그 사람들을 돌려보냈고, 그들은 떠나갔다.
ko.R: 게하시는 언덕에 이르자 종들에게서 자루와 옷을 받아 집 안에 감추어 두었다. 그리고 그 사람들을 돌려보냈다. 그들은 돌아갔다.

decisions.choice: the hill: a mound or raised, fortified place
decisions.reason: The word names a swelling or a hill, often the fortified height of a city (2 Chronicles 27:3; Micah 4:8). Here it is a place in Samaria near the house, whose location is now unknown.

decisions.choice: stored them in the house: Gehazi hid the goods before going to Elisha
decisions.reason: The verb means to put something in safekeeping. "The house" is probably the house where Elisha and Gehazi lived. Gehazi sends Naaman's men back at the hill, so they do not come with him to the prophet.

decisions.choice: Gehazi; the things, the bags and clothes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Gehazi and what he took, which the Hebrew leaves understood.

source.text: וְהוּא־בָא֙ וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע מֵאַ֖יִן גֵּחֲזִ֑י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־הָלַ֥ךְ עַבְדְּךָ֖ אָ֥נֶה וָאָֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went in and stood before his master. And said to him Elisha, From where, Gehazi? And he said, Not has gone your servant here or there.

en.L: And he went in and stood before his master. And Elisha said to him, "From where, Gehazi?" And he said, "Your servant has not gone here or there."
en.B: Then he went in and stood before his master. Elisha asked him, "Where have you been, Gehazi?" He said, "Your servant has not gone anywhere."
en.R: Then Gehazi went in and stood in front of his master. Elisha asked him, "Gehazi, where have you been?" Gehazi answered, "I have not been anywhere."

es.L: Y él entró y se puso delante de su señor. Y Eliseo le dijo: «¿De dónde, Giezi?». Y él dijo: «Tu siervo no ha ido a ninguna parte».
es.B: Luego entró y se presentó delante de su señor. Eliseo le preguntó: «¿De dónde vienes, Giezi?». Él respondió: «Tu siervo no ha ido a ninguna parte».
es.R: Después Giezi entró y se presentó delante de su amo. Eliseo le preguntó: «Giezi, ¿dónde has estado?». Giezi respondió: «No he ido a ninguna parte».

fr.L: Et il entra et se tint devant son maître. Et Élisée lui dit : « D’où [viens-tu], Guéhazi ? » Et il dit : « Ton serviteur n’est allé ni ici ni là. »
fr.B: Puis il entra et se présenta devant son maître. Élisée lui demanda : « D’où viens-tu, Guéhazi ? » Il répondit : « Ton serviteur n’est allé nulle part. »
fr.R: Ensuite Guéhazi est entré et il s’est présenté devant son maître. Élisée lui a demandé : « Guéhazi, où es-tu allé ? » Guéhazi a répondu : « Je ne suis allé nulle part. »

sw.L: Naye akaingia, akasimama mbele ya bwana wake. Elisha akamwambia, "Umetoka wapi, Gehazi?" Akasema, "Mtumishi wako hakwenda huku wala huko."
sw.B: Kisha akaingia, akasimama mbele ya bwana wake. Elisha akamwuliza, "Ulikuwa wapi, Gehazi?" Akasema, "Mtumishi wako hakwenda popote."
sw.R: Kisha Gehazi akaingia, akasimama mbele ya bwana wake. Elisha akamwuliza, "Gehazi, ulikuwa wapi?" Gehazi akajibu, "Sikwenda popote."

vi.L: Rồi Ghê-ha-xi đi vào đứng trước mặt chủ mình. Ê-li-sê nói với anh: "Ghê-ha-xi, con từ đâu đến?" Anh nói: "Đầy tớ thầy chẳng đi đâu cả."
vi.B: Rồi Ghê-ha-xi vào đứng trước mặt chủ mình. Ê-li-sê hỏi: "Ghê-ha-xi, con đã đi đâu?" Anh đáp: "Đầy tớ thầy chẳng đi đâu cả."
vi.R: Rồi Ghê-ha-xi vào đứng trước mặt chủ mình. Ê-li-sê hỏi: "Ghê-ha-xi, con đã đi đâu vậy?" Ghê-ha-xi đáp: "Con chẳng đi đâu cả."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 들어가서 자기 주인 앞에 섰다. 그러자 엘리사가 그에게 말했다. "게하시야, 어디서 [오느냐]?" 그러자 그가 말했다. "선생님의 종은 이리저리 가지 않았습니다."
ko.B: 그러고 나서 그는 들어가 자기 주인 앞에 섰다. 엘리사가 그에게 물었다. "게하시야, 어디에 갔다 왔느냐?" 그가 대답했다. "이 종은 아무 데도 가지 않았습니다."
ko.R: 그러고 나서 게하시는 들어가 주인 앞에 섰다. 엘리사가 물었다. "게하시야, 어디에 갔다 왔느냐?" 게하시가 대답했다. "저는 아무 데도 가지 않았습니다."

decisions.choice: from where
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text spell this word in a shorter form, and the margin of the text gives the usual spelling. Both mean "from where".

decisions.choice: here or there: anywhere
decisions.reason: The pair of words means "anywhere at all". Gehazi's answer is a second lie (verse 22).

decisions.choice: your servant: a polite way of saying "I"
decisions.reason: Gehazi uses the humble form of speech even as he lies to his master.

decisions.choice: Where have you been? (Balanced, Readable); I (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable complete Elisha's short question. Readable says "I" for "your servant".

decisions.choice: "Đầy tớ thầy" (L, B); "Con" (R)
decisions.reason: A polite way of saying "I" (m3), in the forms Gehazi uses with his master.

decisions.choice: Gehazi calls himself "선생님의 종" (L), "이 종" (B), "저" (R) to Elisha
decisions.reason: As Elisha to Elijah (2:2), a disciple-servant calls the prophet "선생님".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ לֹא־לִבִּ֣י הָלַ֔ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר הָֽפַךְ־אִ֛ישׁ מֵעַ֥ל מֶרְכַּבְתּ֖וֹ לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ הַעֵ֞ת לָקַ֤חַת אֶת־הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ וְלָקַ֣חַת בְּגָדִ֔ים וְזֵיתִ֤ים וּכְרָמִים֙ וְצֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר וַעֲבָדִ֖ים וּשְׁפָחֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to him, Not my heart went when turned a man from on his chariot to meet you? [Is it] the time to take the silver and to take garments and olive groves and vineyards and sheep and cattle and male slaves and female slaves?

en.L: And he said to him, "Did not my heart go [with you] when a man turned from his chariot to meet you? [Is it] the time to take the silver and to take clothes, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male slaves and female slaves?
en.B: But Elisha said to him, "Was not my heart there with you when a man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is this a time for taking money and taking clothes, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and cattle, male slaves and female slaves?
en.R: But Elisha said to him, "Did you think I did not know? My spirit was with you when the man stepped down from his chariot to greet you. This is not the time to take money and clothes. It is not the time to take olive groves and vineyards, sheep and cattle, or slaves, both men and women.

es.L: Y él le dijo: «¿No fue mi corazón [contigo] cuando un hombre se volvió de su carro a tu encuentro? ¿[Es] tiempo de tomar la plata y de tomar ropa, olivares y viñas, ovejas y bueyes, esclavos y esclavas?
es.B: Pero Eliseo le dijo: «¿No estaba mi corazón allí contigo cuando un hombre se volvió de su carro para salir a tu encuentro? ¿Es este momento de tomar dinero y de tomar ropa, olivares y viñas, ovejas y bueyes, esclavos y esclavas?
es.R: Pero Eliseo le dijo: «¿Creías que yo no lo sabía? Mi espíritu estaba contigo cuando ese hombre se bajó de su carro para saludarte. Este no es momento de tomar dinero ni ropa. No es momento de tomar olivares ni viñas, ovejas ni bueyes, ni esclavos ni esclavas.

fr.L: Et il lui dit : « Mon cœur n’était-il pas allé [avec toi] quand un homme est descendu de son char à ta rencontre ? [Est-ce] le moment de prendre de l’argent et de prendre des vêtements, des oliveraies et des vignes, du petit et du gros bétail, des esclaves et des servantes ?
fr.B: Mais Élisée lui dit : « Mon cœur n’était-il pas là, avec toi, quand un homme est descendu de son char pour venir à ta rencontre ? Est-ce le moment d’accepter de l’argent et d’accepter des vêtements, des oliveraies et des vignes, des moutons et des bœufs, des esclaves hommes et femmes ?
fr.R: Mais Élisée lui a dit : « Tu croyais que je ne savais pas ? Mon esprit était avec toi quand cet homme est descendu de son char pour t’accueillir. Ce n’est pas le moment de prendre de l’argent et des vêtements. Ce n’est pas le moment de prendre des oliveraies et des vignes, des moutons et des bœufs, ou des esclaves, hommes et femmes.

sw.L: Akamwambia, "Je, moyo wangu haukwenda [pamoja nawe] mtu yule alipogeuka kutoka garini mwake kukulaki? Je, huu [ni] wakati wa kupokea fedha na kupokea mavazi, na mashamba ya mizeituni na mashamba ya mizabibu, na kondoo na ng'ombe, na watumwa wa kiume na watumwa wa kike?
sw.B: Lakini Elisha akamwambia, "Je, moyo wangu haukuwa pamoja nawe mtu yule alipogeuka kutoka garini mwake kukulaki? Je, huu ni wakati wa kupokea fedha na mavazi, mashamba ya mizeituni na mashamba ya mizabibu, kondoo na ng'ombe, watumwa wa kiume na watumwa wa kike?
sw.R: Lakini Elisha akamwambia, "Je, ulidhani sikujua? Roho yangu ilikuwa pamoja nawe mtu yule aliposhuka kutoka garini mwake kukusalimu. Huu si wakati wa kupokea fedha na mavazi. Si wakati wa kupokea mashamba ya mizeituni na mizabibu, kondoo na ng'ombe, wala watumwa wa kiume na wa kike.

vi.L: Ê-li-sê nói với anh: "Chẳng phải lòng ta đã đi [theo con] khi có người quay xuống khỏi xe để đón con sao? Đây có phải là lúc để nhận bạc, nhận quần áo, vườn ô-liu, vườn nho, chiên, bò, tôi trai và tớ gái sao?
vi.B: Nhưng Ê-li-sê nói với anh: "Chẳng phải lòng ta đã ở đó với con khi có người quay lại xuống xe để đón con sao? Đây có phải là lúc để nhận bạc, nhận quần áo, vườn ô-liu, vườn nho, chiên, bò, tôi trai và tớ gái không?
vi.R: Nhưng Ê-li-sê nói với anh: "Con tưởng ta không biết sao? Tâm linh ta ở đó với con khi người ấy bước xuống xe để đón con. Đây không phải là lúc để nhận tiền bạc và quần áo. Cũng không phải là lúc để nhận vườn ô-liu, vườn nho, chiên, bò, hay nô lệ, cả nam lẫn nữ.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그에게 말했다. "한 사람이 너를 맞으려고 자기 병거에서 돌아섰을 때에 내 마음이 [너와 함께] 가지 않았느냐? 지금이 은을 받고 옷을 받고, 올리브 밭과 포도원과 양과 소와 남종과 여종을 받을 때냐?
ko.B: 그러나 엘리사가 그에게 말했다. "그 사람이 너를 맞으려고 병거에서 내려 돌아섰을 때에 내 마음이 거기 너와 함께 있지 않았느냐? 지금이 돈을 받고 옷을 받고, 올리브 밭과 포도원과 양과 소와 남종과 여종을 받을 때냐?
ko.R: 그러나 엘리사가 말했다. "내가 모를 줄 알았느냐? 그 사람이 너를 맞으려고 병거에서 내릴 때에 내 영이 너와 함께 거기 있었다. 지금은 돈이나 옷을 받을 때가 아니다. 올리브 밭이나 포도원이나 양과 소나 남종과 여종을 받을 때가 아니다.

decisions.choice: did not my heart go with you?: I was with you in spirit and saw what happened
alternatives: My heart did not depart [from you]
Was not my heart going [with you]?
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is very brief: "Not my heart went?" Read as a question, it means that Elisha was present in his inner self and knew all that Gehazi did, as prophets are given to see what is hidden (6:12). It can also be read as a statement, "My heart did not go away", meaning that Elisha was not unaware; the sense is close. The wording is hard and its exact force is uncertain.

decisions.choice: is it the time?: now is not the time
decisions.reason: The question expects "no". With Naaman newly turned to Yahweh, and with the healing given freely, this was no time to profit from it (verse 16).

decisions.choice: olive groves, vineyards, flocks, herds and slaves: what the silver could buy
decisions.reason: Elisha lists the property a man could acquire with the money: land, animals and servants. He sees what Gehazi meant to do with his gain. The list echoes the warning of what a king would take (1 Samuel 8:14-17).

decisions.choice: a man turned from his chariot: Naaman turned and got down
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn. Naaman turned from his chariot, that is, got down and turned to meet Gehazi (verse 21).

decisions.choice: male slaves and female slaves at every level
decisions.reason: The slaves are listed as property to be acquired with money, so "slave" is kept at every level, as the style of this translation does where people are owned or bought.

decisions.choice: Did you think I did not know?; statements for the second question
decisions.reason: Readable adds a short question that says what Elisha's words imply, and turns the rhetorical question into two statements. The added question goes beyond the Hebrew and rests on the reading in meaning decision m1.

decisions.choice: esclavos y esclavas (every level)
decisions.reason: The slaves are listed as property bought with money, so "esclavo" stays at every level; Spanish has the masculine and feminine forms the Hebrew has.

decisions.choice: "tôi trai và tớ gái" (L, B); "nô lệ, cả nam lẫn nữ" (R)
decisions.reason: Slaves bought with the silver, as the English keeps "slaves" at every level; Vietnamese "tôi trai, tớ gái" is the old word pair for bond servants.

decisions.choice: "남종과 여종" for male and female slaves
decisions.reason: "종" is the word these drafts use for *ʿeved*; "남종과 여종" is the natural Korean pair.

records.literal_gloss: And [the] scale disease of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever. And he went out from before him having scale disease, like snow.

en.L: And the scale disease of Naaman shall cling to you and to your offspring forever." And he went out from before him with scale disease, like snow.
en.B: So Naaman's skin disease will cling to you and to your descendants forever." And Gehazi went out from his presence with a serious skin disease, as white as snow.
en.R: So Naaman's skin disease will now cling to you and to your descendants forever!" When Gehazi left Elisha, he had the serious skin disease. His skin was as white as snow.

es.L: Y la enfermedad de la piel de Naamán se te pegará a ti y a tu descendencia para siempre». Y salió de delante de él con enfermedad de la piel, como la nieve.
es.B: Por eso la enfermedad de la piel de Naamán se te pegará a ti y a tus descendientes para siempre». Y Giezi salió de su presencia con una enfermedad grave de la piel, blanco como la nieve.
es.R: ¡Por eso ahora la enfermedad de la piel de Naamán se te pegará a ti y a tus descendientes para siempre!». Cuando Giezi salió de donde estaba Eliseo, tenía la enfermedad grave de la piel. Su piel estaba blanca como la nieve.

fr.L: Et la maladie de la peau de Naaman s’attachera à toi et à ta descendance pour toujours. » Et il sortit de devant lui atteint de la maladie de la peau, [blanc] comme la neige.
fr.B: La maladie de peau de Naaman s’attachera donc à toi et à tes descendants pour toujours. » Et Guéhazi sortit de chez lui atteint d’une maladie de peau grave, blanc comme la neige.
fr.R: La maladie de peau de Naaman va maintenant s’attacher à toi et à tes descendants pour toujours ! » Quand Guéhazi a quitté Élisée, il avait cette maladie de peau grave. Sa peau était blanche comme la neige.

ko.L: 그러니 나아만의 악성 피부병이 너와 네 자손에게 영원히 붙어 있을 것이다." 그러자 그가 악성 피부병이 들어 눈처럼 [되어] 그 앞에서 나갔다.
ko.B: 그러므로 나아만의 피부병이 너와 네 자손에게 영원히 붙어 있을 것이다." 게하시는 심한 피부병이 들어 눈처럼 하얗게 되어 엘리사 앞에서 물러 나갔다.
ko.R: 그러므로 이제 나아만의 피부병이 너와 네 자손에게 영원히 붙어 있을 것이다!" 게하시가 엘리사 앞에서 나갈 때에, 그는 심한 피부병에 걸려 있었다. 그의 피부가 눈처럼 하얬다.

decisions.choice: Naaman's disease will cling to you: the punishment fits the sin
decisions.reason: Gehazi took what was Naaman's, and now he takes Naaman's disease. The disease "clings" as Naaman's silver had been carried to him. "To your offspring forever" makes it a curse on his line, as in 1 Samuel 2:31-33 and 2 Samuel 3:29.

decisions.choice: like snow: probably white, or flaking like snow
decisions.reason: The same comparison is used of Moses' hand and of Miriam (Exodus 4:6; Numbers 12:10). It most likely describes white patches of diseased skin; it may refer to flaking skin. The disease itself is the one named in verse 1.

decisions.choice: he went out from before him: Gehazi left Elisha's presence
decisions.reason: Gehazi is named again in 8:4-5, where he tells the king about Elisha. The story does not say how that meeting fits with his disease.

decisions.choice: as white as snow (Balanced, Readable); with a serious skin disease
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the likely meaning of "like snow" explicit, as meaning decision m2 explains; Literal keeps the bare comparison. They name Gehazi and Elisha for "he" and "him".

decisions.choice: the narrator calls Gehazi "anh"
decisions.reason: Gehazi is the prophet's young servant; the narrator keeps the plain "anh" through his fall rather than judging him with "hắn".
